jobs.title: Banking Operations Officer
jobs.description:
• Main Responsibilities

• The banking operations officer is responsible for the day-to-day activity, control and oversight of the BAU activity as directed by their reporting line.

• The role requires the candidate to support the banking operations department across numerous activities as required by their manager, to deliver high quality standards of work. This presents the opportunity to demonstrate existing knowledge, in addition to being presented with the opportunity to upskill on other areas within the department.

• It is critical to remain positive and proactive in this role, supporting colleagues and having a desire to increase their own knowledge and support others.

• Support of constant improvement initiatives and projects will be required from time to time.

• Role Duties

• The local Banking Operation department is divided into two separate teams as detailed below :
• Banking & Treasury
• UK Domestic payments (Sterling)

• Direct Debits & Standing orders

• Cheque clearing

• Treasury support activities

• Client reporting, online banking & Debit cards
• Client reporting, including valuations and mailings

• Individual Savings Account controls - ISA

• Client debit card support and helpline

• Online banking support and helpline

• Management of physical documents (mail / archives)

• The successful candidate will initially join an area which makes best use of their skillset and experience, with a later consideration to crosstrain as required by the bank.

• Important to support colleagues within banking operations and work with a one team approach.

• Proactively manage Risks and Issues arising within the banking operations scope

• Produce KPI’s for banking operations and provide periodic reporting against KPI’s for Senior Management as defined

• Support the business with development of operational solutions for new products or services in conjunction with the Operational teams at Union Bancaire Privee SA

• Ensure operational functions meet relevant regulatory requirements at all times

• Perform all duties in accordance with the principles outlined in the UBP UK Code of Conduct, as well as the policies and procedures relevant to the role, adhering to a culture that focuses on minimising risks and delivering value

• Ensure adherence to UBP Internal controls standards, systems and procedures that appropriate standards are maintained in all aspects of operational risk and compliance which are endorsed by subsequent audits.

• The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management.

• Committee Membership

• None

• Conduct Rules

• This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:

•

• To act with integrity;

• To act with due skill, care and diligence;

• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;

• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;

• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and

• To act to deliver good outcomes for retain customers.

• Person Specification

• Knowledge, Skills & Experience

• At least 8 years working in a similar operational role, able to demonstrate technical knowledge across banking operations.

• A min of 3 years working with critical outsource/service providers.

• Able to engage at all levels and build strong relationships across jurisdictions.

• Proactive, positive and solutions focused.

• Competencies and Values Required Level

• Shows the drive to perform and be successful 5
 Persistent in following up on issues 5
 Upholds the legal, regulatory and ethical standard of the UBP Group 4
 Good product knowledge 4
 Knowledge of legal regulatory and industry requirements 4
 Business Development 4
 Communication - listening, written and verbal with clients 4
 Influencing 4
 Knowledge of Products and Services 4
 Relationship Building - internal and external 4
 Strategic & commercial awareness 4
 Planning & organising 4
 Ethics and values 4
 Customer focus 4

• Explanation: 1: low level of competence / skill required, 2-3: average level of competence / skill required, 4-5: high level of competence skill required

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst - Credit (IT)
jobs.description:
• Mission

• The mission consists in performing the role of IT business analyst for key credit applications and projects

Main responsibilities:

• Reporting to the Team Lead of IT Risk, Credit & ESG, the consultant will work on key credit applications projects.

BA Responsibilities:

• Analyse business scenarios/cases and contribute to business requirements definition.

• Define Functional Design Specification.

• Manage vendor application (SpeciTec) relationship (software package Specicred ).

• Install and test new version of Specicred.

• Execute database scripts and queries (SQL) to validate data integrity and ensure alignment with regulatory requirements.

• Liaise with the business to provide guidance from an IT point of view.

• Provide guidance for business analysts, developers, and testers assigned to the projects and ensure good project management practices are employed throughout the project lifecycle.

• Identify key risks and issues and define mitigation scenarios.

• Your Profile

• 5 to 10 years of experience

• Education : Master Degree in IT

• Experience required

• Strong experience required: IT Business Analyst with strong technical and functional skills on Credit projects

• Good understanding of the bank’s business processes

• Good operational experience in the implementation of various IT Credit projects

• Languages:

• French mandatory and English (C1)

• Others

• Swiss residency: Mandatory

jobs.title: Team leader - IT Compliance
jobs.description:
• Mission:

• Team leader of the IT Compliance unit ensuring the delivery and operations of all the services used by the bank Compliance entities at Group and Branch levels

• In charge of managing a team of 11 IT specialists composed of business analysts and project managers

• Key responsibilities:

• Manage the daily operations of the team and the related services to meet the expected level of quality

• Manage the portfolio of projects and ensure the proper delivery on time by meeting the business requirements within the approved budget

• Manage the team OPEX and CAPEX budgets within the approved envelopes

• Manage the team resources by setting individual objectives and developing their career path

• Specific Competencies and other Skills/Abilities:

• Master Degree in IT Engineering or equivalent.

• A minimum of 10 years’ experience as IT Team Lead in a banking organization

• Functional knowledge of Compliance, KYC, AML and regulatory reporting topics in the context of Private Banking

• Technical knowledge of the IMTF AML and risk scoring solutions

• Capacity to deal with several matters simultaneously

• Ability to work independently, take decisions and set priorities

• Pragmatic and solution oriented

• Strong leadership, analytical and communication skills, ability to interact at management level with key bank stakeholders

• Fluent in French and English; additional languages are considered an asset

• Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Investment Advisor
jobs.description:
Mission
 The Investment Advisor is responsible for delivering tailored investment advice and portfolio strategies to high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Working closely with Relationship Managers (RMs), the IA ensures client receive comprehensive, risk-appropriate investment solutions aligned with their goals, profile, and the Bank’s values.

Main responsibilities

• Provide customized investment advice based on client objectives, risk appetite and market conditions

• Construct and optimize investment portfolios using a broad range of asset classes

• Act as the trusted investment contact for existing clients, in partnership with RMs

• Assist in client meetings, prepare proposals and contribute to the acquisition and onboarding of new clients as well as for business retention

• Promote and explain investment products to RMs and relevant target advisory client groups

• CFA, CIIA, CWMA or similar certification is a strong asset

• Strong knowledge of investment products and ability to execute trades for equities, derivatives, fixed income, bonds, warrants and mutual funds

• Min 5 years of experience in a similar position in Private Banking or a Financial Institution

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, client focus, reliability, flexibility and stress resistant

• Good command of MS Office suite, portfolio analysis tools and banking software

• Perfectly fluent in French and English. Very good knowledge of Russian and any additional language skill would be an added value.

• Adaptability to work in an agile organization

• Swiss Residence

jobs.title: Structured Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Mission & Main responsibilities

• Product Management:
• Oversee the booking process for new structured products and ensure effective life cycle monitoring of existing products.

• Manage post-trade services for the EMEA team, including the creation of products in internal systems and mapping products into team tools.

• Act as a liaison between Bankers, Advisors, Middle Office, and Back Office teams to ensure seamless communication and coordination.

• Digital Development and Process Optimization:
• Identify opportunities for improvement in both automated and manual tasks, providing actionable feedback and suggestions.

• Design, develop, and maintain Excel-based tools to support the Structured Products team in their daily operations.

• Contribute to the enhancement of digital processes to improve efficiency and accuracy in team workflows.

• Contribute to automation of the booking process.

• Ensure the best execution in a secure framework in open architecture
• Pricing of structured products in a secure operational framework

• Focus on flow products (in comparison to solution products)

• Ensure best execution in accordance with regulatory requirements

• Management of the Issuer relationship, with a focus on the search for internal group synergies

• Back up of the Solutions activity in case of needs

• Development of tactical trade ideas
• Design, analysis, and selection of SP tactical ideas (trading axis, market opportunities etc.)

• Promotion of new payoffs within subscription products

• Client focus:
• Provide expertise and support to internal partners and clients

• Take initiatives to achieve quantitative objectives for the structured products business

• Build relationship with private bankers

• Favour internal synergies

Your Profile

• Education: Master degree in Financial Markets

• Experience Technical skills - 5y of experience on Structured Products field

• Languages - English, French, German, others

• Personal skills - Team player, agile, Pro active, ability to take initiatives, business developpement & service oriented

• IT skills: Programming proficiency with at least one major language, such as Python. Excellent knowledge of the Pandas and NumPy packages. Proven experience in project development or automation using this expertise / data management and data analysis.

• Others: Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Team Head Cash Services
jobs.description:
• Mission
 Within the COO division, part of the Group Operations, the Cash Services Department covers the following areas:
- Transfers & payments;
- Cash counter, Clients’ safes and Client care center (CCC);
- The Money Market & FX transactions;
- The Cards activity.
The mission of the department is to make sure that the bank’s, contractual or regulatory, obligations are fulfilled, in line with its policies and procedures, especially in a more and more strict and complex environment but also bearing in mind the excellence in the service to clients.
The mission of the Head of Cash Services is to provide proper guidance and support to the teams to achieve this goal.

• Main responsibilities
• Coordinate and organise the work of the department
• Delegate appropriately the tasks to each team leader.

• Provide guidance based on the top management direction.

• Make sure, with a clear communication of the bank’s policies and procedures, that a correct risk assessment is made and, if need be, escalation is timely done according to the level of risk.

• Implement relevant monitoring and controls framework
• Identify any risk (operational and regulatory)

• Identify, implement and report quantitative and qualitative reporting

• Challenge procedures and routines.

• Coordinate with internal or external counterparties
• Act as an advisor and coordinator vis-à-vis branches and subsidiaries across the Group, sharing best practices, standardising processes and controls when possible.

• Maintain good relationship with all stakeholders of the bank to provide support and advise.

• Develop a network of professionals with other institutions to keep abreast of systems and regulations evolutions.

• Continuously improve the set up
• Be actively involved in all projects impacting the department from TOM definition to tests and implementation

• Propose measures to increase efficiency, quality and productivity.

• Provide team leadership and coaching
• Lead by example: behaviour consistent with words

• Adopt change with a positive attitude. Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way

• Communicate effectively and be able to take decisions including in difficult situations

• Coach and help develop team members: identify good and low performers and take appropriate actions to develop them or solve dysfunctional behaviour

• Your Profile
• Strong knowledge in Cash Services activities and processes

• MS Office and major banking software

• Experience and proven success in running similar position

• English is a requirement, other languages a plus

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Tax Specialist
jobs.description:
• Mission
 We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Tax Specialist to join our Client Documentation and Tax Services Department.
As part of the Fiscal Reporting team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and quality of our clients’ tax statements, while collaborating with various departments and external providers.
This is a unique opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, stimulating environment and contribute to impactful projects across the bank.

• Main responsibilities
• Tax Statement Review & Validation
• Review and validate tax statements for over 20 international jurisdictions, including Switzerland, France, Portugal, Mexico, and others.

• Ensure that tax documents comply with local and international regulations before being sent to clients.

• Data Quality Assurance
• Collaborate with our external provider to ensure the quality and accuracy of tax data before statement production.

• Identify and correct anomalies or inconsistencies in the data to ensure reliable reporting.

• Client Support & Front Office Interaction

jobs.title: Graduate Programme - Operations office team

titleByLocale.it: Programma di laurea - Team dell'ufficio operativo

jobs.description:
The Bank’s entire operations are managed by COO Division and are headed up by the Chief Operating Officer. It strives to provide both in-house and external clients with a first-rate service to ensure our business operates efficiently and at the best possible cost. The COO division comprises Operations, Finance, Information Management, Human Resources and Logistics. COO employees are committed to providing, with professionalism and enthusiasm, an efficient, proactive, high-quality service that meets the needs of clients within the context of the Bank’s overall strategy.

• Mission :

• Permanent contract and training programme of 12 months, based on a rotation through various departments of the COO team

• The purpose is to acquire targeted professional skills as well as practical experience

• You will learn to manage projects, build stakeholder relationships, and conduct change management

• You will be supported by a mentor, and a “buddy” during the entire programme

• This programme is dedicated to young graduates, with a Master’s degree and a maximum of 12 months’ global professional experience, seeking to discover the Banking industry

• It includes the prospect of obtaining a permanent role within UBP Operations Team

• Main responsibilities :
 1. Operations – Monitoring and Reconciliations

• Understand the role of the Operations department, and the roles of the different teams within Operations

• Understand Operations processes and propose process improvements where applicable

• Participate in coordination tasks of transversal topics / projects within Operations department

• Help to realise reportings and collect inputs from other teams on regular reportings

• Understand and support Reconciliation’s activity and investigations

2. Banking Operations

• Join an Operations team

• Support the processes of the teams in line with internal procedures and policies

• Support the cash services and securities services by discovering transfers, treasury operations, stock exchange and settlement activities.

3. Risk management department

• Join the risk management team

• Understand the different roles within the risk team

• Understand Operational risk going through incident management, RCSA…

• Support risk processes

• Your Profile :

• Master’s degree in finance or Information Technology obtained recently at a highly recognised university

• Maximum 12 months’ professional experience

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, ability to partner with other teams

• Fluent in French and English; any other language would be a plus

• Excellent knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite especially Excel, programming skills is a plus

• Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Team player

• Others :
• Swiss Residence

Applications :
 Applications must be made through our careers website and must include a CV and a cover letter.
 Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Stock exchange / Settlement Officer
jobs.description:
TEMPORARY MISSION - 9 MONTHS

Mission :

•

• Settlement of equities, bonds, structured products​ and investment funds transactions.

• Main duties :

• Monitoring of pending transactions.

• Control and monitoring positions.

• Contact with traders, custodians and counterparties.

• Respect the process and its implementation in relation to operational requirements and volumes as directed by the bank.

• Core competencies :

• Think in "Problem-Action-Results" terms
 • Show strong client service ethic
 • Be proactive and driven
 • Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way
 • Be a continuous learner
 • Adopt change with a positive attitude
 • Consistently comply with internal & external regulations
 • Go beyond specific assignments, walk the extra mile
 • Seek opportunities to improve the existing
 • Be open to other's idea's
 • Balance personal and team interests
 • Seek opportunities to improve quality in all features of the work environment
 • Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures

• Specific Competencies :

• The complete flow of a transaction

• The parties involved on the market (counterparties, custodians, clearing, companies)

• Financial instruments (equities, bonds, structured products, investment funds)

• Good management priorities and ability to deal with sensitive situations

• Other Skills/Abilities :

• CFC bank or equivalent

• Ability to work within a team

• French/English

• MS Office / banking software / Swift

• Knowledge of Omgeo and Euclid is a plus

• Others :

• Swiss Residence

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Client Documentation Specialist
jobs.description:
• Mission

As part of the Client Documentation team, the Client Documentation Specialist is a key element to ensure:

• A smooth documents process flow between the different departments of the bank, especially regarding change in circumstances

• The quality, coherence and the accuracy of the client's data in the bank's systems

• The relevance of clients' instructions by performing control signature

• An efficient support to the other departments of the bank and the branches

• Main responsibilities

Day to day business

• Review the documentation received from the clients for certain change in circumstances on an existing account or an account closing and verify that it complies with the local and international regulations (e.g. CDB20, Common Reporting Standards (CRS) and FATCA/QI rules) and the Bank's directives and procedures from (i) a formal point of view (e.g. the correct version of the document is signed, all the required fields have been completed) and (ii) that the information is consistent across the documents provided by the clients (IDs, corporate documents, bank's forms, etc…)

• Verify that the information entered in the Bank's systems by the Wealth Management is complete according to the documentation signed

• Perform 4 eyes controls and regular internal controls to ensure respect of the procedures

• Ensure a good quality of service by providing accurate feedback to the Wealth Management on any error, missing document and answering in a timely manner to any query related to his/her mission and duties

Coordination and central point of contact

• Build a bridge and create synergy within the Client Documentation team and other key players (Legal, Compliance, IT…), create/maintain an efficient flow of communication that ensures all remain aware of important information and that it is consistent

• Act as a business partner by bringing his/her expertise and the relevant support and input to the other departments of the bank (Wealth Management, Compliance, Legal…) when required (on a complex situation, on the implementation of new regulations or bank's decisions, new projects)

• Coordinate efforts to help a smooth flow in the processes and always seek for improvements

• Facilitate problem solving and collaboration

• Create an environment oriented to trust, open communication and cohesive team effort

Projects and Change management

• Be up to date on any changes in the regulations, perform the assessment for internal changes, communicate with the relevant departments involved and to the team, implement them or launch projects, requests to IT as needed

• Participate in any project impacting the team, either required by a new regulation or initiated by the Bank, hence participate to workshops, meetings, upon the management delegation (for defining the business requirements, performing the testings, and any other required tasks)

• Involve the other team members as required

• Participate in the change management within the team by communicating proactively on the various projects and accompany the team in the change

• Make sure that the procedures and processes are updated accordingly and communicated to all stakeholders, including the Client Documentation teams within the different branches.

• Your Profile

• Education: Bachelors Degree

• Experience Technical skills: At ease with Microsoft tools, especially Excel

• Languages: English is a requirement, German/Italian or other language is a plus

• Personal skills : Client service oriented, Curiosity and good interpersonal skills

• Swiss Residence mandatory

Core Competencies :

• Open mind and team orientation: Be open to other's ideas. / Balance personal & team interests. / Express opinion and criticism in a constructive way.

• Innovation and development: Seek opportunities to improve the existing. / Be a continuous learner. / Adopt change with a positive attitude.

• Professional business culture: Think in 'Problem-Action-Results' terms. / Walk the extra mile. / Be proactive and driven. / Show strong client service ethic. / Build lasting client relationships.

• Quality, internal & external regulations: Consistently comply with internal & external regulations. / Seek opportunities to improve quality in all features of the work environment.

• Analytical Ability : Ability to assimilate procedures and to implement them. / Ability to identify issues and raise them in a structured way. / Ability to make process improvements. / Attention to detail.

• Solid organization and time management skills: Ability to organize the tasks efficiently based on priorities with anticipation of events. / Reaction and decision-making ability in face of unforeseen circumstances.

• Communication: Ability to raise issues via the right channel and in a constructive way. / Ability to expose constraints and opportunities. / Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way.

• Adaptability: Ability to change, be flexible. / Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.

• Team Spirit : Ability to proactively help the others. / Ability to finalize the common goal.

jobs.title: Phone Operator
jobs.description:
• Mission
• Manage a high-volume, high-standard French/English switchboard (additional languages are an asset), administer the VOIP system (AGILE), and handle CFF travel arrangements.

• Join a private bank and interact with a wide range of stakeholders: various departments, VIPs, and senior executives.

• Main responsibilities

• CISCO VOIP system management:

• Handle external and internal calls with strict confidentiality and exceptional courtesy.

• Rigorously enforce security standards, particularly regarding phishing attempts and malicious calls.

• Manage call transfers and message taking using the Samwin operator console.

• Cover Executive Management calls during assistants’ breaks and absences, as well as for certain management groups.

• CFF travel management:

• Provide support and advice for domestic CFF travel.

• Process requests for international travel.

• Manage the renewal of CFF subscriptions.

• Ticketing and facilities requests:

• Administer the ticketing system for facility management requests (e.g., ventilation).

• Coordinate with relevant stakeholders, ensure follow-up, and close action items.

• Your Profile

• Experience:

At least 5 years of experience in a similar role within a highly demanding environment is required Technical skills

• Languages:
• French and English must be mastered perfectly (minimum C1 level).

• Any additional language is an asset.

• Personal skills:
• Motivated, dynamic, proactive, and compassionate professional with a service mindset.

• Natural aptitude for pedagogy, able to make technical topics accessible and easy to understand.

• Active listening skills with both internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong stress management, maintaining composure in all circumstances.

• Discreet and tactful, exercising restraint and professionalism at all times.

• Team-oriented, committed to sharing knowledge, fostering collective intelligence, and learning from the surrounding experience.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Funds Execution Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Fonctionnaire chargé de l ' exécution des fonds

jobs.description:
• Mission
 Ensure the accurate and timely execution of client fund orders across Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, and Private Equity Funds for all UBP branches, while maintaining strict compliance with internal processes and regulatory requirements. Deliver exceptional service to clients to ensure seamless end-to-end fund order processing.

• Main responsibilities

Execute client fund orders across Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, Private Equity. Mutual funds are processed primarily via SWIFT through a global custodian while Alternatives (HF/PE) are placed directly with fund administrators, including completion of required subscription/redemption documentation and KYC/AML. Coordinate funding, settlement, and confirmations; manage pre-funding, notice periods, and specific terms (gates/lock-ups).

• Your Profile

• Education and Technical Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Economics (or equivalent).

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer - Wealth Management
jobs.description:
• Mission
 The candidate will be part of the Data Intelligence & Digitalisation team within Wealth Management and will take part in the development of the digital platform for private bankers. The Wealth Management is currently enhancing its digital platform with the objectives to better integrate data and services for bankers and clients. The candidate will have to work in a complex environment involving technical and business challenges with many stakeholders.

• Main responsibilities

• Participate in the development effort of the digital platform

• By integrating existing web services into a new user experience

• Develop screens and navigation in the intranet Portal

• Design and implement new features across the existing software stack

• Define and challenge upcoming features from a technical perspective

• Navigate through a large set of existing databases and write optimized queries against them

• Work closely with business and quantitative analysts to ensure that technical solutions are feasible and meet the needs of the business

• Your Profile

• 3 to 5 years experience

• Excellent computing and analytical skills. In particular, the ability to drill-down in existing code in the absence of any documentation

• Proactive and user-focused, with a genuine interest in the functional as well as technical aspects of each challenge encountered

• Full-stack development across .NET 8.0 (C#) and legacy .NET Framework applications, plus JavaScript (Vue.js)

• Knowledge of web-based application development. Interest in UI/UX. Knowledge of PrimeVue and AG grid will be a plus

• Broad experience of databases. SQL (Oracle) will be used as well as Entity Framework

• Knowledge of continuous integration/continuous deployment (ideally with Azure Devops, Ansible, Jenkins and GIT)

• The ability to adapt to and learn new skills and techniques in a very dynamic and changing environment

Nice to have

• Worked in an Agile development environment with Jira

• Knowledge of finance and banking is a plus

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: WM Business Risk Manager

titleByLocale.it: Gestore del Rischio Business di WM

jobs.description:
Mission
 The Business Risk Management team plays a key role within the Wealth Management (First Line of Defence). Business Risk Managers (BRM) are the internal referents within Front Office on the subjects of AML, CDB, Risk Appetite and KYC/KYT, and are responsible of opening client accounts and addressing transactional alerts for lower account risk categories.
 Main responsibilities

• Manage onboarding of client accounts end-to-end.

• Perform formal controls on all risk level client onboardings and review the documentation to ensure that it complies with the local and international regulations (CDB, CRS, FATCA) as well as the Bank’s directives and procedures.

• Perform reviews of onboarding file (AML, KYC, KYT, adverse news screening to mitigate risks) prior to Onboarding (lower risks) or Compliance submission (higher risks) with a strong focus on standard and medium risk relations for material checks.

• Ensure documentary accuracy and completeness of corroborations and evidences in adherence to the Bank’s qualitative risk appetite and standards.

• Ensure that, when applicable, the SLA for onboarding is respected.

• Ensure appropriate documentation of, review and close all normal and medium risk Transactional alerts clarified by the front office in a timely manner.

• Launch Event Driven updates following transactional activity shifts and change in Circumstances in the client life cycle to keep KYC/KYT in line with the client’s activity.

• Escalate any deviations from the Bank’s standards to line management and control functions according to policies in place.

• Upon Management’s request, act as a relay of authority within the WM Markets on certain initiatives.

• Apply the changes required by Compliance Quality Control feedbacks in a continuous improvement manner.

• Digital and manual input in the Bank’s systems relating to account openings.

• Collaborate actively across markets with BRMs and Senior BRMs to balance workloads, protect deadlines, and leverage specific market expertise when required.

• Any other task required by Management relating to the Mission of the employee.

Your Profile

• University degree (Bachelor) or a qualification considered equivalent.

• Private Banking, Central file or WM Compliance or equivalent background with strong understanding of CDB, AML, tax regulations and sanctions matters. Any previous experience with MEA markets is an added value.

• Min 5 years of experience.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the flexibility to seamlessly interact with different levels of seniority and authority.

• Good command of the Bank’s systems and MS Office suite. Knowledge of Power-BI is a plus.

• Fluent in French and English. Any additional language skill is an added value, in particular Arabic.

• Solution oriented team player, capable of working independently.

• Stress resistant, reliable, and flexible.

• Able and willing to learn, acquire new skills and grow in an agile organization.

Others

• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.description:
• Mission
 Operating in a highly regulated banking environment (FINMA, EBA, DORA, etc.) and amid accelerating digital transformation – including the expansion of e-banking and mobile banking services, the Group Risk Department is seeking a senior cybersecurity specialist to carry out second-line control activities.
Independent of first-line operational teams, the role holder contributes to ensuring the effectiveness, consistency, and regulatory compliance of the Bank’s cybersecurity framework.

• Main responsibilities
• Execute the second-line control plan across the full cybersecurity perimeter: IAM, PAM, endpoints, cloud, networks, e-banking and mobile banking.

• Conduct periodic and thematic controls on security processes and measures implemented by first-line operational teams, to ensure that information security risks are identified, assessed, treated, and reported to relevant stakeholders.

• Verify compliance with banking regulatory requirements (e.g., FINMA, EBA, DORA, etc.).

• Produce well-documented control reports, issue actionable recommendations, and monitor the progress of remediation plans.

• Contribute to maintaining cyber risk indicators (KRI/KPI), and feed reporting to the Head of Cyber Risk Control.

• Maintain a regulatory watch specific to the banking sector, and flag impacts on the control framework.

• Work collaboratively with Internal audit and Group Security, within a three lines of defense model.

• Support first-line teams in understanding control requirements and fostering a cyber risk culture tailored to the banking sector.

• Your Profile
• Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems Engineering, or a business school with a specialization in security

• Minimum 7 to 12 years of experience in cybersecurity, ideally in a banking institution

• Good command of frameworks and working knowledge of FINMA circular on operational resilience, DORA, EBA Guidelines on ICT and Security Risk.

• Good understanding of technical architecture (network, cloud, IAM, AD, fraud prevention).

• Ability to document findings clearly and communicate them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Analytical rigor, autonomy, and a collaborative working style.

• Proficiency in French and English, both written and spoken.

• Core Competencies
• Critical thinking and objectivity in assessing control frameworks.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with diverse stakeholders.

• Proactiv, solution-orient mindset when facing identified risks.

• Professional integrity and respect for confidentiality.

• Appetite for regulatory watch, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: System Engineer - Messaging Specialist
jobs.description:
• Mission :

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services.

Challenges:

• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank.

• Main responsibilities:

• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.

• Design, implementation, and management of the Exchange infrastructure

• Monitor and optimize email server performance, storage, and capacity planning

• Manage the Archiving solution, based on Enterprise Vault, ensure retention and compliance rules are applied

• Prepare and operate the transition to the Cloud Solution

• Design, implementation, and management of Citrix-related technologies,

• Provide production support for our Microsoft environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Manage and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing downtime and mitigating impacts on business operations.

• Implement and maintain system monitoring solutions to pre-emptively identify potential issues (SCOM / NIMSOFT).

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system enhancements and integration of new technologies.

• Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures, including regular system audits and updates.

• Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and lead problem management processes.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.

• Be part of an on-call service rotation one week per month (24/24-7j/7)

• Must have with strong expertise in :

• Microsoft Infra (AD, DHCP, SCOM)

• Exchange 2019 and email security solutions

• SCCM

• Powershell scripting

• MS Team

• Ansible

• Nice to have :

• M365

• Intune

• Citrix

• AirWatch MDM Mobility plateform

• Others

• Swiss Residence

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Assistant Relationship Manager LATAM
jobs.description:
Mission
 Assist the relationship manager(s) in opening new relationships and serving clients, in compliance with
 the Bank’s internal regulations and guidelines within the Hispanic Markets.
 Main responsibilities

• Prepare the necessary documentation for client meetings and business trips for relationship managers

• Handle and monitor stock exchange orders, forex transactions, fiduciary relationships, loans, payment orders and credit card applications

• Provide administrative support to the Team Head

• Cash Management

• Assist in AML clarifications and prepare clients KYC and related updates

• Direct interaction with clients by phone, e-mail and, occasionally in meetings

• Prepare and monitor account openings, closings and mutations

• Maintain records in compliance with internal and external regulation (for example: portfolio reviews, AML, KYC, etc.)

• Perform other administrative tasks as needed (for example: preparing presentations, travel arrangements, helping clients with any requests, banking and non-banking, etc.)

• Deputy of other assistants if needed

Your Profile

• Degree in a related field (banking apprenticeship, CYP, banking internship or similar)

• Private Banking certificate, SAQ or other equivalent certification a plus

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role or within private banking

• Strong banking, Compliance and KYC knowledge

• Team spirit, inter-personal skills, highly service and client oriented as well as communication skills

• Fluent in French, Spanish and English. Any additional language is an added value

Others

• Swiss Residence is mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: WM Business Monitoring Officer (EAM controls)

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del monitoraggio aziendale WM (controlli EAM)
titleByLocale.fr: Agent de surveillance des activités de la MG (contrôles de la MAE)

jobs.description:
Mission
 As Business Monitoring Officer you will manage EAM's onboarding at group level and ensure the completion of the yearly EAM control plan and keep it up to date. You will also deliver commercial, administrative and operational support to the Market Heads and the respective teams.
 Main responsibilities

• Performing first line of controls as per the EAM Control Plan and Management & Functional Controls framework

• Designing, implementing, and monitoring specific action plans and projects. Identifying areas for improvement in existing procedures and processes

• Ensuring relevant documentation is requested, obtained, and registered as part of the EAM on boarding

• Supporting the EAM teams on commercial, administrative, and operational day to day or exceptional requests

• Continuously improving and automating activity

• Delivering any other task required by Management relating to the Mission of the employee

Your profile

• Degree in a related field (banking apprenticeship, CYP, banking internship or similar)

• Minimum 3 year in control tasks in a Swiss Banking environment

• Proficiency in Compliance and Regulatory matters surrounding External Asset Management

• Fluent in French and English. Any additional language is a plus

• High proficiency in MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Power BI, SQL language, MS Power Query, SAP Business

• Ability to embrace a strategic vision and translate it in simple, pragmatic, and feasible solutions

• Strong analytical, naturally well-organized, and curious mindset with excellent research skills

• Assertive, open, and constructive communication, both written and verbal

• An open, flexible, and confident team-player who can quickly adapt to new challenges

• Self-disciplined, goal-oriented, having a "Problem-Action-Results" approach

• Openness to new ideas and be force of proposition

Others

• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

titleByLocale.en: Compliance Quality control specialist - Temporary 6 months

jobs.description:
Mission

As part of a team of eight, the Compliance Control specialist will help to implement the control plan, which covers all compliance-related activities.

Challenges
To contribute to the achievement of the Bank’s objective of maintaining a risk control framework of the highest standard.
 Role Description
• Review the design and effectiveness of controls in place for various compliance-related activities (financial crime, anti-money laundering, know-your-customer, sanctions, investor protection, cross-border operations, etc.)
• Lead or participate in control reviews by conducting diagnostics and carrying out detailed testing.
• Identify areas for improvement and recommend corrective actions.
• Monitor the timely implementation of recommendations and action plans.
• Work closely with Compliance, Business Risk & Controls Departments to ensure execution of controls and resolution of issues.
• Produce high quality working papers and control reports in accordance with the CCRM methodology.

Your Profile
 Education: University Degree (Business / Law)
 Year of Experience: 3-7 years
 Skills & Requirements: Compliance, Audit, Internal control
 Languages:
 French: Fluent
 English: Fluent
 Swiss residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Investment Content Designer (Temporary 12 months)
jobs.description:
Mission
 A creative role at the heart of investment.
Within Investment Marketing, we are looking for a talented designer. You will be a full member of the Investment Management team, helping define how our investment thinking is structured, articulated, and presented to Wealth Management, to clients, to investors.
At the intersection of portfolio management, strategy and other business lines, you transform complex financial expertise into clear, structured and visually compelling materials.
You ensure that investment communication is rigorous, compliant with regulatory requirements, and fully aligned with the identity and standards of an international investment group.

• You design the materials that shape how investment specialists communicate their conviction.

• Your output has immediate visibility with investment digital platforms.

• You have real influence over the visual and editorial standards of the Investment Management team

Key Responsibilities

• Investment Content
Structure and formalise investment views
Translate complex financial analysis into clear, pedagogical narratives
Ensure consistency between investment philosophy and client communication
Contribute to multi-asset strategy articulation and portfolio frameworks

• Editorial & Visual Design
Lead the design of strategic presentations, outlook publications and investment solutions documentation
Maintain high visual standards aligned with private banking expectations
Build clear message hierarchies and rigorous visual architecture
Ensure coherence across asset classes and publication formats

• Digital Integration
Oversee content production in Adobe InDesign, related design tools and adapt for digital platforms
Contribute to the investment content distribution strategy
Enhance client experience across digital investment platform

• Governance & Standards
Coordinate cross-functional initiatives within Investment Management
Ensure regulatory soundness of all materials in close collaboration with Compliance
Drive continuous improvement of production, validation and deployment processes
Define and harmonise editorial and visual standards at group level

Profile

• Experience
Background in private banking, asset management or investment banking
Demonstrated ability to structure complex investment content
Experience in a regulated financial communication environment
Strong interest in the digital evolution of investment content

• Education
Higher education in finance, economics or a related discipline.
A background in graphic communication or design is considered a strong advantage.

• Languages
French - fluent or native
English - fluent, written and spoken
Additional languages are an advantage

• Technical skills
Advanced proficiency in Adobe InDesign — essential
Illustrator and Photoshop — an advantage
Familiarity with regulated financial communication requirements
Experience adapting investment materials for digital platforms
Understanding of multi-asset reporting frameworks

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Corporate Action Specialist
jobs.description:
CORPORATE ACTIONS - TRADITIONNELLES

• Daily business responsibilities

• Handle activities of one of the following pools:

• Receipt of information:

• Cross analyze information received: custodians swifts, agent/Funds prospectus and financial providers (such as Bloomberg, Telekurs)

• Create adequate corporate event in the corporate action database

• Answer to questions from Relationship Managers, other internal departments, external parties including clients.

• Notification of information:

• Write announcement to Relationship Managers and Clients

• Instruction processing:

• Reconcile holdings, determine entitlements, manage pending positions.

• Collect and follow up on instructions

• Transmit instructions to our correspondents, Funds manager and/or other external parties, control of their safe delivery and acceptance

• Allocation to clients:

• Book corporate actions events in clients’ accounts (cash and/or securities)

• Review the overnight bookings

•

• Overall responsibilities

• Follow-up on various topics and issues over the lifecycle of a Corporate Action

• Interchange from one pool to the other, depending on needs

• Collaborate with others team members outside the assigned pool

• Core competencies

• Think in "Problem-Action-Results" terms

• Be proactive and driven

• Show strong client service ethic

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures

• Highly organized, manage tight deadlines within a high-risk environment, ability to work under pressure

• Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify problems and propose solutions.

• Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way

• Be a continuous learner

• Adaptability, self-motivation and teamwork

• Good understanding of the risks inherent to the corporate actions environment and demonstrate good discipline around control and escalation.

• Build lasting client relationships

• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Financial Controller - Retrocession Specialist
jobs.description:
Mission
Your primary mission is to calculate retrocessions (commissions) payable to External Asset Managers (EAMs) and business introducers across the Group.
 Main responsibilities

• Receive, digitize, and file contracts.

• Enter base data into the dedicated commission system.

• Control and correct source data used in commission calculations.

• Verify calculations, including VAT computation.

• Interact with and respond to questions from Group Accounting, the EAM department, and Relationship Managers.

• Verify provisions related to retrocessions.

• Run simulation scenarios for retrocession calculations for new contracts.

• Enter and validate non-full-STP (non-automated) retrocession domains.

• Produce various reports (statistics, accounting entries creation, supporting documents dispatch).

General competencies

• Consistently comply with internal and external regulations.

• Seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment at all levels.

• Maintain quality standards while meeting deadlines.

Your Profile

• 5+ years’ experience desired in accounting or administration.

• Precision, flexibility, rigor, adaptability, strong sense of responsibility and service, stress resilience, and ability to meet deadlines.

• Strong organizational skills and discretion.

• Good command of standard office tools (Excel, Word; Business Objects is a plus). Knowledge of the

• Quartal Commission system is a strong advantage.

Languages
 Native French or bilingual level; very good command of English (spoken and written).
 Personal skills

• Open and transparent communication.

• Critical thinking.

• Strong capacity for innovation (open to new ideas and continuous improvements).

• Firm and mature approach in challenging situations.

Others

• Comfort working with partial or non-automated workflows and validating edge cases.

jobs.title: Financial Controller - Transfer Pricing & Analytics

titleByLocale.it: Controllore finanziario - Prezzi di trasferimento e analisi
titleByLocale.fr: Contrôleur financier - Prix de transfert et analyse

jobs.description:
Mission
Support the bank’s Management Control function by structuring and governing the profit-center hierarchy, driving transfer pricing (SLA) calculations and revenue allocations, and enhancing profitability analyses. Lead data quality and automation initiatives (primarily in Excel/VBA, with Business Objects/SQL/Power BI as assets) to deliver reliable monthly reporting, budgeting, and forecasting in close collaboration with Accounting, IT, and Business teams.
 Main responsibilities

Hierarchy and governance:

• Manage and maintain the profit-center hierarchy, including AuM and revenue splits by legal entities, business lines, and geographies.

• Validate reference data (cost/profit centers, P&L by management groups) to ensure consistency, traceability, and auditability.

Transfer pricing (SLA):

• Participate in transfer pricing calculations and allocate revenues across accounting entities.

• Document allocation rules, trace methodologies, and contribute to coherence controls and reconciliations.

Profitability calculations:

• Contribute to profitability calculations and models (formulas, inputs, simulations) for products, clients, and business units.

• Prepare variance analyses and validation materials for management review and governance committees.

Data, tools, and automation:

• Develop ad hoc automation projects (Excel/VBA/Business Objects/SQL) to streamline data flows and reporting processes.

• Improve data quality through controls, alerts, and accounting vs. management reporting reconciliations.

• Produce and enhance dashboards and KPIs (AuM, revenues, profitability by BU/product/client).

Support and coordination:

• Provide support to the Head of Management Control for monthly reporting, budget, and forecast cycles.

• Collaborate with Accounting, IT, and Business stakeholders to align processes, ensure data integrity, and deliver accurate outputs.

Your Profile
 Education
 Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Management, or HES (University of Applied Sciences) in Business/Economics/Finance.

Experience and Technical skills

• Initial experience in management control, audit, or finance within a banking environment.

• Solid foundations in management accounting: cost and revenue allocation, profitability analysis.

• Excellent command of Excel with VBA and a strong appetite for process automation.

• Knowledge of Business Objects, SQL, and/or Power BI is an advantage.

• Familiarity with banking KPIs (AuM, revenues, margins) and multi-axis reporting (entity, business line, geography) is advantageous.

• Comfort working with SLAs, documented allocation rules, and traceable methodologies.

Languages
 Professional proficiency in English; additional languages are an asset.

Personal skills

• Rigorous, analytical, autonomous, and detail-oriented, with strong critical thinking.

• Strong documentation mindset and attention to data quality and controls.

• Collaborative, able to coordinate with cross-functional teams (Accounting, IT, Business).

• Problem-solving mindset and ability to work under deadlines in a monthly closing context.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Database administrator
jobs.description:
Mission
 We are seeking a skilled and experienced Database Administrator (DBA) to join our team in Geneva. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successfully installing, managing, and maintaining database systems. This role requires a proactive individual with a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and a commitment to ensuring the security, performance, and reliability of our database infrastructure. Experience with Data Guard and RMAN is highly desirable, and familiarity with data lake implementation is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration
• Install, configure, monitor, and maintain database systems, including Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
• Perform database troubleshooting, including performance tuning, technical issue resolution, and backup/restore operations.
• Manage and administer corporate data to ensure consistency, accessibility, and security.
• Define and implement technical database architectures, including clustering, replication, and high-availability solutions.
• Provide database support for development teams, ensuring optimal performance and scalability of applications.
• Contribute to the design and implementation of data lake solutions (preferred but not mandatory).

Security & Compliance
• Adhere to and enforce the organization’s security framework, ensuring compliance with established policies and procedures.
• Maintain a strong awareness of security best practices to protect the organization from vulnerabilities and potential exploits.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure database systems align with security and compliance requirements.

Collaboration & Innovation
• Work closely with cross-functional teams to support business objectives and deliver high-quality database solutions.
• Stay updated on emerging database technologies and trends, recommending improvements to existing systems and processes.

Skills & Experience

Experience
• Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience in database administration.
• Proven expertise in managing and optimizing Sybase, Oracle, and SQL Server databases.
• Experience with Data Guard and RMAN is highly desirable.
• Experience in data lake implementation is a plus.

Technical Skills
• Proficiency in database management tools and technologies, including DataGuard, RMAN, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
• Strong knowledge of database performance tuning, backup and recovery strategies, and high-availability solutions.
• Familiarity with database security best practices and compliance standards.

Soft Skills
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality solutions.
• Detail-oriented, organized, and able to work efficiently under pressure.
• Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities and business needs.

Languages
• Fluency in English and French is required.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Junior Transformation Officer
jobs.description:
• 1. Position Summary

• The Junior Transformation Officer plays a key role in driving the execution of Group Compliance’s transformation agenda. The role focuses on monitoring project progress , following up on key initiatives , and supporting operational teams in the formalisation of documents, deliverables, and governance materials.

• Working closely with the Chief of Staff and the leadership team, the Junior Transformation Officer helps ensure that strategic projects are well structured, tracked, and delivered on time . This includes preparing and consolidating content for steering committees and management meetings, running smaller projects or workstreams end-to-end , and contributing to the continuous improvement of methods, templates, and tools.

• This position is an excellent opportunity for a junior professional to gain exposure to strategic topics, change initiatives, and senior stakeholders within Group Compliance.
 2. Key Responsibilities
 Project and initiative follow-up

• Track the progress of key projects and initiatives within Group Compliance (milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies).

• Maintain and update project dashboards and trackers, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.

• Follow up with project owners and workstream leads on actions, deadlines, and open points, and escalate issues when required.

• Contribute to the identification of risks and issues, and support the definition and follow-up of mitigation actions.

Running projects and workstreams

• Take ownership of smaller projects or specific workstreams within larger programmes (from scoping to delivery).

• Coordinate stakeholders, plan activities, and monitor progress against objectives and timelines.

• Contribute to change management activities (communication, awareness sessions, simple training materials) when relevant.

Content preparation and formalisation

• Support operational teams in the formalisation of project documentation (charters, roadmaps, action plans, status reports).

• Prepare and structure presentations and briefing materials for steering committees, management meetings, and other governance forums.

• Contribute to the standardisation and improvement of templates (slides, reports, action logs, decision logs).

Continuous improvement and support

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of ways of working within Group Compliance (process simplification, better tracking, clearer documentation).

• Help identify and implement efficiency gains

3. Competencies and Skills
 Technical and organisational skills

• Strong data, organisational and planning skills; ability to manage multiple deadlines in parallel.

• Very good command of MS Office tools (PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI); experience with collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, OneNote, etc.).

• Ability to structure information, summarise discussions, and formalise decisions and action plans.

• High level of reliability, discretion, and professionalism.

• Strong sense of ownership and follow-through; proactive in chasing and closing actions.

• Attention to detail combined with the ability to prioritise.

• Strong interpersonal skills; able to interact with senior stakeholders with confidence and tact.

• Team player, flexible, and service-oriented mindset.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in Science, Management or a related field.

• 1–3 years of experience in a similar role (Executive Assistant, Project Management Officer, Committee Secretary, or Chief of Staff support) in a banking or financial services environment is an asset.

• Experience in preparing minutes, tracking actions, and supporting governance forums is highly valued.

• Previous exposure to an international and multicultural environment is a plus.

Behavioural competencies

4. Education and Experience

5. Languages

• English and French: fluent spoken and written.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Client Documentation Contractor
jobs.description:
• Key Accountabilities
• Perform daily tasks including:

• review of name screening by the system as first level of control and determine if further Compliance assessment and review is required

• data capture and validation in the Core Banking System

• Provide support to the team on daily routines (i.e. data entry)

• Support client documents filing and archiving

• Support team member to coordinate and handle ad hoc mailing with Business Management as required

• Work with the outsourced service provider for mailing and scanning of client documents

• Comply with external and internal compliance and regulatory requirements, including the Bank’s policies, operating procedures and controls to meet the Bank’s and regulatory requirements and protect the business from financial and reputational risk

• Requirements
• At least 3-5 years of relevant hands-on experience in account opening and client onboarding

• Good understanding of AML and KYC regulatory requirements

• Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel

• Proven self-starter with the ability to work independently

• Strong team player and able to work under pressure

• Good communication and inter-personal skills

• Able to interact effectively with Front Office Business

• Fluency in written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin)

jobs.description:
• Mission

We are looking for our new team member, passionate about ITIL processes and Vulnerability Management, willing to be part of a team which is at the crossroads or all IT departments and addressing a large variety of subjects that help the IT department achieving A class results

• Main responsibilities

- Escalate, coordinate, animate committees, report and communicate on IT Major Incidents
 - Review, assess, validate, animate CAB, report and communicate on IT Changes
 - Log, coordinate, keep track, animate sessions, and report on IT Problems
 - Log, coordinate, keep track, report on Vulnerabilities and animate Vulnerability Management meetings

• Your Profile

- Master degree in IT and/or Security
 - 5 years experience in Incident / Change / Problem / Vulnerability management
 - Fluency in French and English
 - Experience with Nessus or Qualys scanning tools (build & operate scans)
 - ITIL certifications
 - Team player, ability to work in autonomy but as a member of a team with shared responsibilities and goals
 - Ability to work under stress, list priorities, build action plan and follow the plan
 - Excellent communication skills, orally and in written. Ability to animate calls with different audiences (technical and management)
 - Flexibility according to work priorities

jobs.title: Wealth Management Assistant (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Mission
 By joining Union Bancaire Privée (Europe) S.A. wealth management division as an Assistant you will provide administrative and operational support the Senior Relationship Managers and customers according to our quality standards and banking regulations.
 Main responsibilities

• Administrative support to Relationship Managers:

• Prepare and organize client‑meeting packs, presentations, and briefing notes.

• Monitor account‑opening processes end‑to‑end, coordinating outstanding items and approvals.

• Collect, validate, and maintain KYC/CDD documentation; track renewals and trigger periodic reviews.

• Update CRM/client records and ensure documentation is audit‑ready.

• Transaction and operations execution:

• Follow up and process client cash movements, stock market orders, deposits, loan instructions.. in a accurate and prompt manner.

• Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, and Front Office to ensure timely settlement and issue resolution.

• Apply regulatory requirements and internal procedures; escalate exceptions and maintain proper controls.

• Reconcile transactions and maintain logs/SOPs for audit and MI reporting.

• Client service and inquiry management:

• Serve as a primary contact for day‑to‑day queries; provide quick, clear updates on requests and cases.

• Proactively communicate status on onboarding, KYC, and transaction execution.

• Identify and address service gaps; contribute to continuous improvement of client experience.

• Uphold high service levels (SLAs, TATs, and quality metrics).

Your profile

• Higher education in Banking, Finance or Wealth Management.

• A previous experience, of 3-5 years, in WM (front-office and facing clients) is required.

• Committed team player with good capacities of working autonomously.

• Client focused with a deep sense of discretion/confidentiality and problem-solving attitude.

• Excellent communication capabilities.

• Being bilingual in English and French is a must. Knowledge of a third language (Portuguese, Italian...) is a considered asset.

• Good knowledge of Administrative IT tools [MS Office].

By joining Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A in Luxembourg you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
 Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neuro diversity.
 In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

titleByLocale.it: RELAZIONE FUNZIONALI E ANALITICI (6 mesi di stage)
titleByLocale.en: WM BUSINESS REPORTING & ANALYTICS (6 months Internship)
titleByLocale.de: WM BUSINESS REPORTING & ANALYTICS (6 Monate Praktikum)
titleByLocale.fr: Rapports d'activité et ANALYTIQUES (6 mois de stage)

jobs.description:
Mission
 The WM Business Reporting & Analytics department focuses on data analysis and reporting, transforming large volumes of data into actionable insights to drive business decisions and success.
 We’re looking for a motivated Business Reporting & Analytics intern to join our team with the opportunity to work with SQL, Power BI, and analytical tools. This 6-month internship offers hands-on experience across reporting, data exploration, lightweight modeling prototypes, and data storytelling
 This 6 months internship offers hands-on learning and participation in impactful projects in the field of analytics and reporting.
 You will play a key role in supporting our reporting efforts by analyzing large datasets, developing impactful reports, and driving data-informed decision-making. This internship offers a unique opportunity for aspiring professionals to gain practical experience in data analytics and reporting, while contributing to meaningful business outcomes.
 Main responsibilities

• Contribute to the design and architecture of data models to improve reporting efficiency

• Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis

• Assist in managing and analyzing large datasets to support reporting needs

• Collaborate with the team to define metrics, KPIs, and analytical requirements aligned with business goals

• Implement data quality checks (completeness, consistency, duplicates) and support data cleaning

• Support the team in ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and quality

• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power-BI

Your Profile

• University degree (Bachelor or Master) or a qualification considered equivalent

• SQL: basic-intermediate (joins, CTEs, aggregations, simple window functions).

• Power BI: basic-intermediate (dashboard development, data modeling, Power Query, basic DAX)

• Up to 0-2 years of experience

• Good command of MS Office

• Fluent in English and French, an additional language is an added value

• Solution oriented team player, capable of working independently

• Stress resistant, reliable, and flexible

• Eager to learn and develop new skills in an agile organization

Others

• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Graduate Programme - Investment Services

titleByLocale.it: Programma di laurea - Servizi di investimento

jobs.description:
• Permanent position with a 12-months rotational program within different Investment Services teams to discover different activities, as well as build expertise and professional skills. Rotation will be arranged for the graduate within IS organization including but not limited to

- Fixed Income / Equity / Funds / Private Markets research and Advisory

- Investment Advisory and Discretionary Portfolio Management Services

- Product Governance and management.

• During the program, under supervision of various Team Leaders / Heads as mentor , the Graduate is expected to gain exposure to the following functional areas:

- Private banking investment advisory framework

- Discretionary Portfolio Management Investment Process and portfolio construction.

- Equity / Fixed Income / external fund manager selection process

- Building blocks of investment portfolios

- Product risk classification and client suitability frameworks for private banks

• At the end of all rotations, the Graduate is expected to be trained in:

- Asset class knowledge - gain some understanding and application of the basic process of screening investment products for opportunities.

- Portfolio Management and Construction - gain some understanding and application of the basic process of portfolio management and construction

- Market profiling – support the development of marketing pitches, as well as propositions for new product.

- Market Research and Analysis – continuously develop investment acumen in the context of investing for high-net-worth individuals and entities.

- Product Management - gain some understanding of the Product control landscape integral to the product governance framework.

• Performing regulated activities

-As part of the integration of the Graduate into the Investment Services team and his/her development to eventually specialise in at least one asset class or service, he/she is expected to take part in regulated activities conducted by the specialists, advisors and Portfolio managers across asset classes.

-These activities will be conducted under the supervision of the respective team heads, and include but are not limited to:

- Assisting RMs and Advisors to explain particular investment propositions in key client pitches and meetings.

- Arranging of timely and regular updates of key instruments held by clients to RMs as part of the comprehensive

“after-
 sales” advisory service.

- Assisting in the development and production of investment proposals and presentations to clients and prospects

- Working with Portfolio managers on portfolio construction and re-balancing.

- Assisting asset class specialist in their activities pertain to research as well as preparation of research /

marketing
 materials.

- Contribute to strategic and tactical trading ideas suitable for the bank’s client base.

• Other expected tasks

- Assist product specialists monitoring investment product exposure to provide necessary performance update to clients and front office teams

- Perform market analysis across coverage sectors and companies in the UBP product universe and provide research communication to front office teams.

- Coordinate with business management, compliance, middle office team, and other key stakeholders to ensure investment
 product offerings, discretionary and advisory services are in compliant with UBP policy.

- Monitor client portfolios to update front office teams for any house view changes, performance alert, investment opportunities, portfolio rebalancing needs, and etc.

- Participate implementation of investment campaign and global launches providing necessary marketing supports to front office teams including product training, marketing materials, order taking, client meetings, joint calls, and etc.

Rationale – Why Investment Services?
 We are a Singapore-based team comprising of various investment teams on the Wealth Management platform that offers Clients the access to UBP’s institutional expertise. Our mission consists of leveraging the UBP local and global investment expertise to propose best in class and timely conviction-driven investment opportunities. Combining Wealth Management Specialist, discretionary and Advisory expertise, our integrated team brings consistently prudent analysis and conviction-driven, in-depth guidance to our clients. Our thought leadership is channelled through our internal and Client-friendly materials including House View, Advisory/Market updates, Macro outlook and Asset Allocation pitches.
 Candidates may consider applying if they are eager to contribute and develop a career as an Investment specialist (multi-asset or an individual asset class / service) who will eventually be responsible to offer investment advice, help manage portfolios and / or handle technical areas, such as the evaluation, development and implementation of Investment product strategy for our Clients and the UBP organisation.
 Skills

• Basic knowledge in excel VBA / at least a programming language e.g. Javascript, Python and C++, will be a plus

• Proficiency in Mandarin would be a plus

• Other expected tasks - Assist product specialists monitoring investment product exposure to provide necessary performance update to clients and front office teams - Perform market analysis across coverage sectors and companies in the UBP product universe and provide research communication to front office teams. - Coordinate with business management, compliance, middle office team, and other key stakeholders to ensure investment product offerings, discretionary and advisory services are in compliant with UBP policy. - Monitor client portfolios to update front office teams for any house view changes, performance alert, investment opportunities, portfolio rebalancing needs, and etc. - Participate implementation of investment campaign and global launches providing necessary marketing supports to front office teams including product training, marketing materials, order taking, client meetings, joint calls, and etc. Rationale – Why Investment Services? We are a Singapore-based team comprising of various investment teams on the Wealth Management platform that offers Clients the access to UBP’s institutional expertise. Our mission consists of leveraging the UBP local and global investment expertise to propose best in class and timely conviction-driven investment opportunities. Combining Wealth Management Specialist, discretionary and Advisory expertise, our integrated team brings consistently prudent analysis and conviction-driven, in-depth guidance to our clients. Our thought leadership is channelled through our internal and Client-friendly materials including House View, Advisory/Market updates, Macro outlook and Asset Allocation pitches. Candidates may consider applying if they are eager to contribute and develop a career as an Investment specialist (multi-asset or an individual asset class / service) who will eventually be responsible to offer investment advice, help manage portfolios and / or handle technical areas, such as the evaluation, development and implementation of Investment product strategy for our Clients and the UBP organisation. Skills
• Basic knowledge in excel VBA / at least a programming language e.g. Javascript, Python and C++, will be a plus
• Proficiency in Mandarin would be a plus
