jobs.title: Assistant Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
Mission
 Assist the relationship manager(s) in opening new relationships and serving clients, in compliance with
 the Bank’s internal regulations and guidelines within our Wealth Management division.
 Main responsibilities

• Prepare the necessary documentation for client meetings and business trips for relationship managers

• Handle and monitor stock exchange orders, forex transactions, fiduciary relationships, loans, payment orders and credit card applications

• Provide administrative support to the Relationship Manager and Team Head

• Cash Management

• Assist in AML clarifications and prepare clients KYC and related updates

• Direct interaction with clients by phone, e-mail and, occasionally in meetings

• Prepare and monitor account openings, closings and mutations

• Maintain records in compliance with internal and external regulation (for example: portfolio reviews, AML, KYC, etc.)

• Perform other administrative tasks as needed (for example: preparing presentations, travel arrangements, helping clients with any requests, banking and non-banking, etc.)

• Deputy of other assistants if needed

Your Profile

• Degree in a related field (banking apprenticeship, CYP, banking internship or similar)

• Private Banking certificate, SAQ or other equivalent certification a plus

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role or within private banking

• Strong banking, Compliance and KYC knowledge

• Team spirit, inter-personal skills, highly service and client oriented as well as communication skills

• Fluent in French and English. Italian or any additional language is an added value

Others

• Swiss residence is mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Operation Specialist
jobs.description:
SECURITIES TRANSFER OFFICER - 6 MONTHS MISSION
 Mission
 Ensure the clients' assets delivery/receipt for all the activities associated with the transfer of securities to a different financial establishment or within the Bank.

This includes all type of assets with expertise primarily required in alternative assets such as mutual funds, Private Equities and Hedge Funds

Effective date : ASAP.

Main responsibilities

• Crossed analysis of the received information: custodian’s swifts, agent prospectus, contract notes and financial providers such as: Bloomberg, Telekurs.

• Perform control of reconciliation of holdings, entitlements determination, pending positions management.

• Be able to manage and control securities transfer instructions received from Wealth Management and external parties (transfer IN/OUT/Internal and funds registration process).

• Control transmission of the deposits to our correspondents/Transfer Agents/Administrators and control of their safe delivery and acceptance.

• Follow-up of the topics and issues over the lifecycle of the securities transfer activities.

• Good understanding of the risks inherent in the Corporate Actions environment related to ongoing securities transfers and demonstrate good discipline around control and escalation.

• Ensure daily follow up in respect of pending issues and take appropriate measures for resolution.

Your Profile

• Education : Master Degree

• Languages : french and english

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: WM Business Risk Manager (Russian Speaking)

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del Rischio Aziendale di WM (Russofono)

jobs.description:
Mission
 The Business Risk Management team plays a key role within the Wealth Management (First Line of Defence). Business Risk Managers (BRM) are the internal referents within Front Office on the subjects of AML, CDB, Risk Appetite and KYC/KYT, and are responsible of opening client accounts and addressing transactional alerts for lower account risk categories.
 BRMs collaborate transversally with other BRMs and Senior BRMs, Market and Region Heads, Relationship Managers, Assistants, Compliance and other stakeholder.
 Main responsibilities

• Manage the end-to-end onboarding of Normal and Medium risk client accounts.

• Perform formal controls on all risk level client onboardings and review the documentation to ensure that it complies with the local and international regulations (CDB, CRS, FATCA) as well as the Bank’s directives and procedures.

• Perform reviews of onboarding file (AML, KYC, KYT, adverse news screening to mitigate risks) prior to Onboarding (lower risks) or Compliance submission (higher risks) with a strong focus on standard and medium risk relations for material checks.

• Ensure documentary accuracy and completeness of corroborations and evidences in adherence to the Bank’s qualitative risk appetite and standards.

• Ensure that, when applicable, the SLA for onboarding is respected.

• Ensure appropriate documentation of, review and close all normal and medium risk Transactional alerts clarified by the front office in a timely manner.

• Launch Event Driven updates following transactional activity shifts and change in Circumstances in the client life cycle to keep KYC/KYT in line with the client’s activity.

• Escalate any deviations from the Bank’s standards to line management and control functions according to policies in place.

• Upon Management’s request, act as a relay of authority within the WM Markets on certain initiatives.

• Apply the changes required by Compliance Quality Control feedbacks in a continuous improvement manner.

• Digital and manual input in the Bank’s systems relating to account openings.

• Collaborate actively across markets with BRMs and Senior BRMs to balance workloads, protect deadlines, and leverage specific market expertise when required.

• Any other task required by Management relating to the Mission of the employee.

Your Profile

• University degree (Bachelor) or a qualification considered equivalent.

• Private Banking, Central file or WM Compliance or equivalent background with strong understanding of CDB, AML, tax regulations and sanctions matters.

• Experience with Eastern Europe markets and financial sanctions regulation.

• Min 5 years of experience.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the flexibility to seamlessly interact with different levels of seniority and authority.

• Good command of the Bank’s systems and MS Office suite. Knowledge of Power-BI is a plus.

• Fluent in French and English, work proficiency in Russian. Any additional language skill is an added value

• Solution oriented team player, capable of working independently.

• Stress resistant, reliable, and flexible.

• Able and willing to learn, acquire new skills and grow in an agile organization.

Others

• Swiss Residence is mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: RFP Specialist (Temporary 12 months)
jobs.description:
• Mission
 Work with the UBP Asset Management division’s RFP Team (Request For Proposal) to fuel the global institutional business generation. Craft convincing tender documents and questionnaires from asset owners and allocators.

• Challenges
• Ramp fast on UBP’s strategies and the Team’s workflow to contribute from day one.

• Bring asset management background with genuine interest across asset classes (long-only and alternatives).

• Show a bias for action: learn quickly, dive in and deliver on time.

• Main responsibilities
• Complete institutional RFPs and questionnaires with clear, compliant, compelling responses.

• Maintain and optimise consultant databases to maximise discoverability and coverage.

• Keep flagship fund due diligence materials current and standardised.

• Orchestrate inputs across Investments, Compliance, Risk and Ops to deliver timely, complete proposals.

• Manage day-to-day tasks and keep internal worksheets organised.

• Your Profile
• Prior experience in similar role is a strong plus.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance or related fields.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point).

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French; additional language is a plus.

• Deliver consistently high-quality work with diligence, accuracy and on-time execution.

• Meticulous attention to detail, able to prioritise and meet deadlines across multiple concurrent requests.

• Highly motivated, productive and efficient.

• Proactive self-starter who thrives both independently and as part of the Team.

• Communicate openly and transparently with stakeholders.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Compliance officer Sanctions & Corporate due diligence

titleByLocale.it: Compliance officer Sanzioni & Corporate due diligence
titleByLocale.en: Compliance officer Sanctions & Corporate due diligence
titleByLocale.de: Compliance Officer Sanktionen & Corporate Due Diligence
titleByLocale.fr: Agent de conformité Sanctions et diligence raisonnable de l'entreprise

jobs.description:
• Mission
• Support the Group Head of Sanctions & Corporate due diligence in the development and implementation of a strong control framework for corporate & shipping accounts.

• Participate in projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the bank's overall sanctions framework.

• Assist Group Sanctions and Corporate due diligence teams in their daily tasks (due diligence on new and existing clients, ad-hoc reviews and monitoring of specific transactions).

• Main responsibilities
• Participate actively to Bank’s projects related to the global sanctions’ framework.

• Perform in-depth reviews of commercial accounts from an AML, Tax and Sanction perspective.

• Ensure compliance with international sanctions programs at UBP Group level by preparing work instructions/ guidance, ensuring and developing suitable tools and processes.

• Perform periodic assessments of specific Group clients, products and/or services to identify any sanctions risks and take corrective actions if appropriate.

• Ensure the Sanction’s watch including mainly SECO, EU and OFAC regimes for UBP Group.

• Assess the impacts of new sanctions regimes across UBP Group and coordinate with other departments/ stakeholders as required.

• Assist and advice transaction monitoring teams for any question related to sanctions and commercial accounts.

• Participate to maintenance and configuration projects/initiatives of Group sanctions tools.

• Investigate and report suspicious transactions to the relevant authorities, ensuring compliance with AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and sanctions regulations.

• Provide day-to-day advice to colleagues in Compliance, BRMs and Front Office on the internal framework related to commercial accounts.

• Participation in reviewing the internal regulatory framework governing the monitoring of transactional activities of commercial accounts.

• Support the Group’s entities in reviewing commercial accounts opened in their books.

• Your Profile
• Master's degree.

• Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) or CAS in Financial Services are preferred.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in AML, Sanctions, Tax or compliance within the financial services industry, ideally in universal banks.

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements related to AML & Sanctions, including specificities linked to shipping and trade finance industries.

• Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory issues to various stakeholders.

• Work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Assist Group Sanctions and Corporate due diligence teams in their daily tasks (due diligence on new and existing clients, ad-hoc reviews and monitoring of specific transactions).
• Main responsibilities
• Participate actively to Bank’s projects related to the global sanctions’ framework.
• Perform in-depth reviews of commercial accounts from an AML, Tax and Sanction perspective.
• Ensure compliance with international sanctions programs at UBP Group level by preparing work instructions/ guidance, ensuring and developing suitable tools and processes.
• Perform periodic assessments of specific Group clients, products and/or services to identify any sanctions risks and take corrective actions if appropriate.
• Ensure the Sanction’s watch including mainly SECO, EU and OFAC regimes for UBP Group.
• Assess the impacts of new sanctions regimes across UBP Group and coordinate with other departments/ stakeholders as required.
• Assist and advice transaction monitoring teams for any question related to sanctions and commercial accounts.
• Participate to maintenance and configuration projects/initiatives of Group sanctions tools.
• Investigate and report suspicious transactions to the relevant authorities, ensuring compliance with AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and sanctions regulations.
• Provide day-to-day advice to colleagues in Compliance, BRMs and Front Office on the internal framework related to commercial accounts.
• Participation in reviewing the internal regulatory framework governing the monitoring of transactional activities of commercial accounts.
• Support the Group’s entities in reviewing commercial accounts opened in their books.
• Your Profile
• Master's degree.
• Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) or CAS in Financial Services are preferred.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in AML, Sanctions, Tax or compliance within the financial services industry, ideally in universal banks.
• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements related to AML & Sanctions, including specificities linked to shipping and trade finance industries.
• Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory issues to various stakeholders.
• Work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

titleByLocale.en: CyberSecurity Frontline Risk and Control Manager
titleByLocale.fr: CyberSecurity Gestionnaire de risque et de contrôle de première ligne

jobs.description:
Mission
 Lead and strengthen UBP’s cybersecurity first line of defence by overseeing Security Risk & Governance and Vulnerability Management. Establish, maintain, and evolve a robust, transparent control framework aligned to global banking regulations (FINMA, EU, UK, Hong Kong, Singapore). Partner with Technology, Business, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to proactively manage cyber risks, ensure regulatory adherence, and safeguard UBP’s clients and assets.

Main responsibilities
 Governance & Risk Management

• Own and evolve the cybersecurity risk management framework, policies, standards, and security controls catalogue for first line of defence.

• Drive risk identification, assessment, and ensure that adequate and achievable treatment plans are defined and implemented in effective timescales.

• Maintain risk registers and key risk indicators (KRIs). Ensure discrete risks are clearly identified, challenged and catalogued without duplication or unnecessary overlap.

• Ensure alignment with group risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices (ISF, NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27005).
 Vulnerability Management

• Lead enterprise vulnerability management strategy and operations (infrastructure, applications, cloud, third parties).

• Oversee vulnerability scanning, assessment, risk-based prioritisation, and timely remediation in line with SLAs.

• Partner with Infrastructure, DevSecOps, and application owners to embed secure-by-design principles and shift-left controls.

• Report on exposure, trends, and risk posture to senior management and risk committees.
 Regulatory Compliance & Audit Support

• Interpret and operationalize cyber requirements across FINMA, EU (including DORA/NIS2 where applicable), UK (PRA/FCA), Hong Kong (HKMA), and Singapore (MAS).

• Prepare evidence and responses for internal/external audits, regulatory exams, and board-level reporting.

• Maintain control mapping to regulatory frameworks; ensure continuous readiness and closure of findings.

• Manage and mentor a small team; build capabilities and career growth for junior staff.

• Communicate complex cyber risk topics clearly to senior management and non-technical stakeholders.

• Champion a risk-aware culture across technology and business functions.
 Leadership & Stakeholder Management

• Champion a risk-aware culture across technology and business functions.

Your Profile

• Experienced cybersecurity risk leader with deep first line of defense experience in financial services.

• Strong knowledge of regulatory environments across Switzerland (FINMA), EU, UK, Hong Kong, and Singapore, with proven ability to operationalize requirements.

• Strategic thinker with hands-on rigor—able to sustain current frameworks while maturing them for scalability and transparency.

• Influential communicator and collaborative partner comfortable engaging senior executives and guiding junior staff.

Education

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, or a related field.

• Relevant certifications preferred: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEH, or equivalent.

Experience Technical skills

• 8–12+ years in cybersecurity with significant exposure to first line risk and control management in a regulated bank.

• Proven track record in:

• Designing and operating cyber risk and control frameworks (policies, standards, KRIs/KPIs, control testing).

• Leading enterprise vulnerability management (tools, processes, SLAs, metrics, remediation governance).

• Regulatory engagement, audit response, and evidence management.

• Cross-border regulatory alignment (FINMA, EU/DORA, UK PRA/FCA, HKMA, MAS).

• Practical familiarity with:

• Frameworks/standards: NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001/27002/27005, OWASP, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK.

• VM tooling & ecosystems: Qualys/Tenable/Rapid7, SAST/DAST, SCA, container and cloud posture management (CSPM), EDR/XDR.

• Enterprise environments: Windows/Unix, networks, databases, microservices, SaaS, public cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP).

• Secure SDLC/DevSecOps and CI/CD integration of controls.

• Reporting and metrics for executive forums and risk committees.

Languages

• English: fluent (written and spoken).

• French - strong advantage.

Personal skills

• Leadership: coaching mindset, able to build high-performing teams and upskill junior colleagues.

• Communication: clear, concise, and audience-appropriate; strong presentation and writing skills.

• Decision-making: risk-based prioritisation, data-driven, and pragmatic under time pressure.

• Collaboration: strong stakeholder management across IT, Risk, Compliance, and business lines.

• Adaptability: navigates ambiguity; balances regulatory rigor with business practicality.

• Integrity: high professional ethics and commitment to client and bank protection.

Others

• Location: Geneva

• Swiss Residence

• Hybrid working arrangements aligned with UBP policy.

• Candidates must have the right to work in the relevant jurisdiction.

• Background checks required consistent with banking standards.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.description:
• Mission & Main duties
• Ensure Group coordination of AML Committee (AMLC), ensuring quality of client files, alignment of information across Group entities, follow-up of actions and committee decisions.
• Provide Group Compliance position aligned with Compliance Senior Management based on a substantiated argument and a strong risk analysis (risks and mitigating factors) on client cases presented.
• Provide support on Group AML standards definition and on projects’ implementation as an AML SME.
• Ensure a consistent Media watch across the Group and take the relevant actions related to important international cases that may impact UBP Reputation.
• Coordinate Group Consolidated supervision on clients. (PEP, Top Ten, others)
• Act as AML SME to embed standards, training, and culture across the Group

• Key Management Responsibilities
 AML Committee and high-risk client submission
• Provide expert guidance to Group entities on cases escalated to Group Compliance.
• Lead the team responsible for AMLC preparation, collecting files, reviewing and ensuring alignment to Group standards, requesting updates/additional information from Group entities.

titleByLocale.it: Risorse Umane Assistant Zurich (100%, German & English)

jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a fast-growing, dynamic, and international Private Bank in Zurich? We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented HR Officer to join our Zurich HR Team. In this role, you will provide essential support to the HR Manager for our Zurich, Basel, and Lugano branches, ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of all HR administrative activities.

Main responsibilites:

• HR administration and lifecycle support:
• Oversee complete employee lifecycle administration, covering onboardings (pre-employment screening), offboarding (final work certificates), internal transfers and lifecycle events (interim certificates, anniversaries, marriages, births, etc.)

• HR data and system management:
• Maintain and update employee data ins HR systems

• Time management system:
• Serve as first-line support for time and attendance queries (leave, overtime, absences) and provide guidance on policies and system use

• Monitor data quality in the time management system; follow up on discrepancies

• E-performance tool support:
• Act as the primary contact for the e-performance tool; guide employees and managers on workflows, deadlines, and troubleshooting basics

• Cross-site HR collaboration (Geneva):
• Coordinate with HR colleagues in Geneva on salary administration, pension fund, insurance, and related topics; ensure timely data exchange and documentation

• Maintain trackers for shared tasks and follow through on agreed actions

• Payroll administration support:
• Prepare a consolidated monthly overview of all payroll-relevant changes and submit it to the Payroll Manager

• Internal HR events and engagement coordination:
• Plan and organize HR events (e.g., Nationaler Zukunftstag, Welcome Days, learning sessions) including scheduling, communications, logistics, and vendor coordination

• HR administration and records management:
• Coordinate end-to -end HR document management (scan, e‑file, archive) for employees’ electronic files

• Prepare and issue standard and ad-hoc HR letters and confirmations

Requirements:

• HR-Assistant diploma

• HR-Fachfrau/HR-Fachmann (eidg. Fachausweis) is a strong advantage for this role

• 2-4 years of experience in a comparable HR support role, ideally within the financial industry

• Comfortable collaborating with senior stakeholders

• Very good German and English skills (minimum C1 level) required. French proficiency and additional languages are a strong advantage

• Strong IT user skills; confident working with HR systems and MS Office/Google Workspace

• High level of independence, responsibility, and reliability; diligent and detail oriented

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills; able to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and deadlines

Start: asap
 Location: Zurich / Due to the responsibilities in this role, working from home is not available; position is fully on-site

Please note that we only accept direct applications submitted through our online tool. Applications via email or through recruitment agencies cannot be considered. We look forward to receiving your complete application: CV, motivation letter, diplomas, relevant certificates/references, including your earliest start date and salary expectations

Apply now and become part of our UBP journey!

jobs.description:
Mission
 We are looking for a new Events & Marketing Manager to join the Communications & Marketing team in the UK. In this role, the individual will

• Contribute to & implement UK marketing and events strategy to establish a distinctive trusted brand

• Leverage off communication and engagement channels with clients, prospects and professional introducers to increase qualified referrals

• Define content and marketing collateral for clients, prospects and business introducers to strengthen brand visibility

• Plan and organise events for clients, prospects and professional introducers

• Define event ROI tracking and follow up process

• Generate marketing-led opportunities through co creation of content and events with external partners

• Support AM in marketing initiatives and events

Responsible for:

• Implement UK marketing and business development strategy across digital and traditional channels aligned to business objectives and brand positioning.

• Lead audience segmentation and value proposition development for clients, prospects, and professional introducers.

• Establish a robust measurement framework with monthly and quarterly reporting.

• Create marketing collateral (brochures, presentations, one-pagers, factsheets, pitch decks) with clear value propositions.

• Plan and execute integrated campaigns and measure content performance

• Partner with front office to qualify leads, lead routing, and SLAs; build lead-nurture workflows.

• Oversee website optimisation (UX, SEO, conversion rate optimisation), landing pages, and marketing automation journeys.

• Establish and manage communication and engagement programs for clients, prospects, and introducers (e.g., tailored newsletters, updates, co-marketing).

• Set up feedback loops and engagement forums with introducers to identify content needs and joint opportunities.

• Track and report on introducer pipeline influence, referral volumes, conversion rates, and revenue attribution.

• Help build the annual events calendar with formats, themes, budgets, and target KPIs (registrations, attendance rate, pipeline influence).

• Develop post-event follow-up and measure impact on pipeline.

• Define and track KPIs across brand, engagement, acquisition, and revenue influence
 Core competencies

• Solid Investment / background - Minimum of 5-10 years' relevant experience in WM/ AM

• Ability to engage with Senior executives , manage expectations, provide guidance

• Long experience with media relations – minimum of 5 years in dealing with media requests and existing network of journalists in the UK

• Proactively promote relevant content in selected media.

• Be result driven and ability to develop impactful initiatives and develop KPI’s

• Project management – The ability to articulate complex projects with different stakeholders; good experience to lead the planning, development, and execution of specific projects

• Content editing Copywriting – Excellent written communications skills; experience to write, rewrite or edit complex /investment communications with a strong command of English;

• Teamwork and Inclusion - Collaborates with other team members and contributes productively to the team's work and output. Flexible, dedicated, respectful, team-player

• Work under pressure - Ability to juggle many projects and meet deadlines in a high-energy, fast-paced environment

• Knowledge of client marketing and compliance guidelines

• Legal understanding of intellectual property issues related to brand usage

In addition to the minimum responsibilities please tick any of the following responsibilities that apply to the role:

[ X ] Comply with all Risk and regulatory obligations where relevant

[ ] Responsibility to act within agreed risk limit (credit/market, etc...)

[X ] Responsibility for ensuring that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal Policies that relate to you, your business or other businesses for which you have any level of responsibility

[X ] Responsibility for reading, understanding and complying with the Company's Conduct and Standards and corresponding regulations. You will be notified of changes to policies in a timely manner through announcements and/or intranet updates

Financial Conduct Authority & Prudential Regulation Authority Conduct Rules

Individual Conduct Rules - All staff covered by Code of Conduct rules are reminded of their obligation to adhere fully to these codes of conduct and failure will be considered as an act of gross misconduct

RULE 1
 You must act with integrity

RULE 2
 You must act with due skill, care and diligence

RULE 3
 You must be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators

RULE 4
 You must pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly

RULE 5
 You must observe proper standards of market conduct

RULE 6
 You must act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers*

* This rule applies to all staff subject to the conduct rules who carry on activity which involves a direct retail client, or end-retail client, and which is in scope of the FCA’s Consumer Duty.

jobs.title: WM Assistant - Greece Team (100%)
jobs.description:
Within our Wealth Management Division, you will join our WM Greece Team in Zurich , which is in charge of substantial international client relationships, providing superior quality level of banking services. The Team is composed of experienced Relationship Managers, Advisors and Assistants.
 Contribute to the Team success by assisting the Relationship Managers in opening new relationships and serving clients, in compliance with the bank’s internal regulations and guidelines.

Main responsibilities:

• Prepare the necessary documentation for client meetings and business trips

• Handle and monitor stock exchange orders, forex transactions, fiduciary relationships, loans, payment orders and credit card applications

• Cash Management

• Assist in AML clarifications and prepare clients KYC and related updates

• Provide administrative support to the Team

• Direct interactions with clients by phone, e-mail and occasionally in meetings

• Prepare and monitor account openings, closing mutations

• Maintain records in compliance with internal and external regulation. For example: Portfolio reviews, AML, KYC, etc.

• Various administrative tasks. For example: Preparing presentations, travel arrangements, support clients with various requests - banking and non-banking, etc.

• Deputizing of other Team assistants

Requirements:

• Degree/Diploma in a related field or further education; Banking Apprenticeship, Bachelor, Master, CYP, CWMA, or similar.

• Work experience as a Relationship Manager Assistant in banking is required

• Excellent command of German and English is mandatory (C1) / French is a strong asset for this role

• Demonstrate a strong ambition and enthusiasm for contributing to the success of a high-performing international Team by delivering exceptional client satisfaction, with a particular focus on clients in the Eastern Europe region

• Motivated and hardworking personality, highly service- and client-oriented, strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Good priority setting, ability to cope with pressure and high volumes

This is a 100% role located in Zurich.
 Start: asap

jobs.title: IT SERVICE DELIVERY
jobs.description:
Job Profile: IT Service Delivery – Team Lead
 Department: COO – IT / IT Service Delivery
 Location: Geneva – On-site (not hybrid)
 Job Type: Full-Time (Permanent)
 Reports To: Head of IT Service Management
 Date: 01.08.2026
 Job Summary

• The IT Service Delivery – Team Lead is responsible for managing the daily operations and governance of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes within UBP, with a focus on Incident, Problem, Change and Vulnerability Management, the ITSM tool (Jira Service Management) and CMDB governance.

• The role ensures a high quality of service to end users and senior management, guarantees strict adherence to ITSM and Vulnerability Management processes, and contributes to the continuous improvement of IT Service Delivery within the Bank.

• Beyond process ownership, the role contributes directly to the continuity of the Bank’s business activities by reducing the impact of IT incidents on the business and improving the overall user experience. The Team Lead acts as a key ITSM reference within IT, steering processes in a data‑driven way and collaborating closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Risk and business stakeholders.

• Key Responsibilities

• IT Incident Management:

• Coordinate and oversee the end‑to‑end IT Incident Management process.

• Ensure timely, clear and audience‑appropriate communication and reporting on IT incidents to end users, IT management and business stakeholders.

• Monitor incident trends, identify recurring issues and propose corrective and preventive actions.

• Ensure that SLAs, regulatory requirements (including DORA) and internal quality standards are met.

• Measure and improve user satisfaction (e.g. post‑incident surveys, CSAT) and minimize business impact and downtime for critical services.

• IT Problem Management:

• Coordinate and oversee IT Problem Management activities.

• Facilitate root cause analysis, ensure appropriate documentation of known errors and maintain a robust Known Error Database.

• Communicate and report on IT problems to IT stakeholders, with a more technical audience than Incident Management.

• Follow up on action plans to prevent recurrence of major incidents and track their effectiveness over time.

• Maintain close communication with the Service Desk to detect patterns and emerging issues, leveraging ITSM data and trends to prioritize high‑impact problems.

• IT Change Management:

• Lead the IT Change Management process: risk assessment, validation, presentation and follow‑up of all IT changes in production.

• Ensure strict adherence to IT Change processes to protect the Bank against undeclared or incorrectly assessed changes.

• Chair or actively participate in Change Advisory Boards (CAB) and ensure proper documentation and communication of decisions.

• Monitor change KPIs (success rate, back‑out rate, incidents related to changes) and drive continuous improvement.

• Align the Change Management process with Agile / DevOps practices used by development and infrastructure teams, while maintaining compliance, stability and security.

• Vulnerability Management:

• Oversee the end‑to‑end Vulnerability Management process in coordination with Cybersecurity and Infrastructure teams.

• Ensure regular vulnerability scanning, assessment and prioritisation based on risk and business impact.

• Coordinate remediation plans, track progress and escalate when deadlines or risk thresholds are not met.

• Ensure alignment between Vulnerability Management and Incident, Problem and Change processes (e.g. remediation via standard or emergency changes).

• ITSM Tool Ownership:

• High School / Maturité / Baccalauréat or higher degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.
• Technical Skills
• ITIL certification (or equivalent IT Service Management framework) required.
• Solid experience with ITSM tools and CMDB concepts, ideally Jira Service Management.
• Good understanding of IT infrastructure and application environments in a banking context.
• Experience with Vulnerability Management processes and tools (e.g. vulnerability scanners, dashboards, remediation workflows) is a strong asset.
• Ability to build and interpret ITSM and operational dashboards (e.g. using built‑in reporting, BI tools) and to use data to drive decisions.
• Experience
• 5–7 years of experience in IT Service Management or a similar role (intermediate management level).
• Experience in the financial sector: mandatory.
• Proven experience in managing Incident, Problem and Change processes and/or leading a Service Delivery team.
• Experience working with security / cyber teams on vulnerability or risk management topics is an advantage.
• Demonstrated experience in managing major incidents and communicating with senior stakeholders during crises.
• Soft Skills
• Strong communication skills (oral and written), with the ability to explain technical topics to non‑technical audiences and to communicate clearly under pressure.
• Customer and service‑oriented mindset, with strong prioritisation and negotiation skills.
• Ability to manage stress and make sound decisions in high‑pressure situations (e.g. major incidents).

• Structured, analytical and data‑driven approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.

• Position based in Geneva, within an international banking environment.

jobs.title: System Engineer - Messaging
jobs.description:
• Mission

• As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services.

• Challenges:

• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank

• Main responsibilities

• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.

• Troubleshoot and improve AD replication, DNS, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).

• Implement and enforce security policies, including password policies, account lockout policies, and auditing.

• Integrate Active Directory with other systems, such as Office 365, Azure AD, and third-party applications.

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for automation of routine tasks and reporting

• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans for Active Directory.

• Setting up and maintaining Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities.

• Design, implementation, and management of Citrix-related technologies,

• Provide production support for our Microsoft environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Manage and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing downtime and mitigating impacts on business operations.

• Implement and maintain system monitoring solutions to pre-emptively identify potential issues (SCOM / NIMSOFT).

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system enhancements and integration of new technologies.

• Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures, including regular system audits and updates.

• Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and lead problem management processes.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.

• Be part of an on-call service rotation one week per month (24/24-7j/7)

• Must have with strong expertise in :

• Microsoft Infra (AD, DHCP, SCOM)

• PKI and certificat management

• SCCM

• Exchange 2019

• Powershell scripting

• MS Teams

• Ansible

• Nice to have :

• M365

• Intune

• Citrix

• AirWatch MDM Mobility plateform

•

• Others
• Swiss Residence

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Structured Products Engineer – Flow & Tactical
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION - UK Date : 16.06.2026

Job title: Structured Products Engineer – Flow & Tactical
 S ector : Investment Management
 Level : TBD
 Operational Unit: PB Structured Products – UK
 Direct reports:
 Hierarchical Manager: Global Head of PB Structured Products
 Functional Manager: Local Head of Investment Services
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ensure the best execution in a secure framework in open architecture – focus on the UK activity
 - Pricing of structured products in a secure operational framework
 - Focus on flow products (in comparison to solution products)
 - Ensure best execution in accordance with regulatory requirements (documentation etc.)
 - Management of the Issuer relationship, with a focus on the search for internal group synergies
 - Back up of the Solutions activity in case of needs.
 - Cover other entities with the rest of the SP team in case of needs.
 Support of the commercial development of the structured products activity in the UK
 - Take initiatives to achieve quantitative objectives for the structured products business
 - Participate in implementing a commercial strategy in coordination with local SP leader
 - Build strong relationship with private bankers and team of bankers
 - Provide expertise and support to internal partners and clients
 - Create and implement products education of internal business partners – or end clients if needed.
 - Deployment of digital tools to internal business partners
 Development of tactical trade ideas
 - Design, analysis, and selection of SP tactical ideas (trading axis, market opportunities etc.)
 - Promotion of new payoffs within subscription products
 Digital development
 - Participate in defining needs and test the Multi Issuers Platform for UK
 - Price discovery and Execution of flow products within the Multi Issuers Platform
 - Deployment of digital tools to internal business partners (trainings etc.)
 - Take initiatives on the digital side to support the local development of the activity
 CORE COMPETENCIES
 Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility
 Compliance with regulations and internal directives

- Client oriented:
 - Client facing & Sales skills
 - Responsible and committed

- Team spirit
 - Pro activity and ability to take initiatives
 - Communication
 - Synergies oriented
 - Empathy and conflict management

- Professional expertise:
 - Product engineering & technical expertise on derivatives
 - Innovation, disruption, creativity
 - Rigorous and attentive to risks

SPECIFIC COMPETENCIES

• Proficiency in English & French is required

• Max 5-year experience as SP Experienced in product engineering & technical expertise on derivatives

• Entrepreneurship and social intelligence

• Strong client facing capabilities

• Strong team player

• Strong organisational capabilities

• Outstanding academic record with relevant masters

jobs.title: Media Relations & Content Specialist
jobs.description:
• Main Responsibilities
• Media Relations
• Support the Head of Media in implementing the Bank’s media strategy across Europe and the Middle East, with a particular focus on French-speaking Switzerland and key satellite markets.

• Coordinate with media agencies across EMEA to align priorities, timelines and deliverables

• Collaborate with Investment Services, regional teams and other subject-matter experts to source spokespeople and content, and coordinate the full approval process.

• Ensure timely, accurate and on-brand responses to journalists and media partners.

• Proactively coordinate interviews, briefings and market commentary with the relevant internal experts.

• Prepare and update key media materials (Q&As, talking points, short bios, background notes) as needed.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists in core financial and business media.

• Content Management & Copywriting
• Contribute to the production of high-quality content that supports the Bank’s positioning in investment strategy and asset management.

• Draft and edit press releases, statements, Q&As and opinion pieces in close collaboration with experts.

• Translate complex investment and market topics into clear, concise and compliant messages.

• Review and challenge the quality of content before it is offered to the media.

• Ensure consistency of tone of voice and alignment with the Bank’s brand and communication guidelines.

• Work in close partnership with the Digital team to amplify media coverage and align content.

• Coordinate with Internal Communications to share key media exposure internally.

• Monitoring & Reporting
• Monitor media coverage of the Bank, its experts and its key themes across EMEA.

• Use media monitoring and analytics tools to track visibility and sentiment.

• Prepare regular reports on media KPIs for the Head of Media and relevant stakeholders

• Your Profile
• Experience and Skills Required
• At least 5 years’ experience in media relations within financial services (banking, asset or wealth management) or in an agency with financial clients.

• Proven track record of working with financial and business media in an international environment.

• Strong understanding of the financial services landscape and media ecosystem.

• Excellent writing and editing skills; strong copywriting abilities under time pressure.

• Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines across regions in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience handling sensitive topics in a regulated context.

• Relationship builder, credible with journalists and confident with senior internal experts.

• Team player with a collaborative mindset and a hands-on, operational approach.

• Tools
• Experience with media monitoring and analytics platforms.

• Comfortable with basic data analysis and reporting for KPIs.

• Languages
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken).

• French speaker mandatory; other European languages are an advantage.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a fast-growing, dynamic, and internationally Private Bank in Zurich? We are looking for an Investment Advisor to join our Eastern Europe Team in Zurich. The Investment Advisor is responsible for delivering tailored investment advice and portfolio strategies to high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Working closely with Relationship Managers (RMs), the IA ensures client receive comprehensive, risk-appropriate investment solutions aligned with their goals, profile, and the Bank’s values.

Main responsibilities:
 • Analyze portfolios and provide customized investment advice based on clients’ objectives, risk appetite, and market conditions.
 • Construct and optimize investment portfolios using a broad range of the Bank’s Preferred Investment Universe asset classes and the Bank’s products and services.
 • Conduct regular portfolio reviews, provide rebalancing recommendations, and monitor performance.
 • Act as the trusted investment contact for existing clients, in partnership with RMs:

• Present investment strategies clearly and transparently, including expected returns, risks, and associated costs.

• Manage direct client relationships on investment topics with full autonomy, review clients’ risk appetite (Client Account Risk Profile (CARP), K&E), and execute transactions with pre-trade controls (investor protection).

• Support the deepening of client relationships and enhance retention through proactive investment insights, as well as promote discretionary portfolio management services.
 • Assist in client meetings, prepare proposals, and contribute to the acquisition and onboarding of new clients, as well as to business retention.
 • Stay abreast of macroeconomic trends, financial markets, and geopolitical developments.
 • Work closely with internal teams; Investment Management, Tax, Wealth Planning, Legal, etc. to align with the Bank’s investment strategy and core values.
 • Promote and explain investment products to RMs and relevant target advisory client groups.
 • Ensure full compliance with Swiss and foreign regulatory frameworks.

Requirements:

• University degree in finance, economics, or a related field.

• Perfectly fluent in English and Russian ; any additional language skills are an asset.

• At least 5 years of experience in a similar position in private banking or at a financial institution.

• CFA, CIIA, CWMA, or a similar certification is a strong asset.

• Strong knowledge of investment products and the ability to execute trades in equities, derivatives, fixed income, bonds, warrants, and mutual funds (multi-asset).

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, client focus, reliability, flexibility, and stress resilience.

• Good command of the MS Office suite, portfolio analysis tools, and banking software.

• Ability to work in an agile organization.

Start: asap
 Location: Zurich

jobs.title: Senior Wealth Planner - Zurich
jobs.description:
You will join the Wealth Planning Team at Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) in Zurich, Switzerland.
 In this role, you will serve clients and partner with Relationship Managers to ensure that wealth planning needs are appropriately addressed.
 You will provide guidance on succession and legacy planning, tax suitability, mobility planning, and wealth structuring—based on each client’s specific circumstances—to create added value and mitigate risk, collaborating with Compliance on an on-demand basis to ensure alignment with KYC/AML requirements and internal policies.
 The role also includes delivering training and presentations on compliant wealth planning strategies and options, helping clients stay ahead of fast-changing, increasingly complex regulations and protect their wealth while maximizing after-tax income, and preparing timely, accurate internal Wealth Planning Alerts and client memorandums on the topics outlined above.

Main responsibilities:

• Proactive engagement with bankers to recognize and anticipate clients’ needs, and to identify, and capture business opportunities.

• Provide and train Private Bankers with up-to-date, relevant technical information to understand impactful tax and legal developments and take proper action.

• Identify, present and discuss appropriate and compliant wealth planning solutions and strategies to meet clients’ needs: deliver customized service and bespoke strategies.

• Meet clients and prospects (including business travel with bankers)

• Actively promote Wealth Planning services across the Bank via ad hoc presentations and publications on selected, high-impact themes; actively support tax and legal wealth-preservation objectives.

• Maintain a high level of technical expertise on dedicated markets and take an effective, risk-based and outcomes-focused approach to mitigate risks.

• Build and maintain a network of intermediaries such as trust and corporate service providers, tax and law firms.

• Comply with external and internal compliance and regulatory requirements, including the Bank’s policies, operating procedures and controls to meet the Bank’s and regulatory requirements and protect the business from legal, financial and reputational risk.

• Integrate with the local team of Wealth Planners based in Zurich; collaborate across UBP Group; report to Head of Wealth Planning – Switzerland, based in Geneva.

• Partner with the Compliance Department to review complex existing cases and fiduciary/ownership structures (trusts, foundations, SPVs) strictly on a Compliance-initiated, on-demand basis; verify beneficial ownership and document structuring rationales in line with KYC/AML policies and cross-border rules.

• Support onboarding for structure-heavy clients only upon Compliance request: UBO identification, rationale, required entity documentation, ownership charts, and justification memos to facilitate Compliance approval.

• Perform periodic and event-driven reviews (e.g., KYC refresh, trigger events) exclusively when initiated by Compliance.

Requirements:

• 12+ years of relevant experience in wealth planning services

• Deep expertise in UK and Anglo-Saxon wealth structuring, with a proven track record of success in these jurisdictions.

• Broad, advanced knowledge across core wealth planning disciplines (tax, legal, succession, governance), evidenced by complex case execution and client impact.

• Academic background in Law or Finance; a degree in Law and/or qualification as a tax lawyer is a strong plus

• Fluency in English and German; additional languages are an advantage

• Confident, persuasive communicator with excellent presentation skills

• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for varied audiences

• Resilient and adaptable: able to perform under pressure, prioritize effectively, and maintain high standards

• Self-motivated, service driven, and relentlessly focused on client outcomes

• Strong team player, highly organized with exceptional attention to detail

This is a 100% role located in Zurich.
 Start: asap

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti unirai al Wealth Planning Team di Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) a Zurigo, Svizzera. In questo ruolo, servirai clienti e partner con Relationship Manager per garantire che le esigenze di pianificazione della ricchezza siano adeguatamente affrontate. Per creare valore aggiunto e mitigare il rischio, collaborando con Compliance su base on-demand per garantire l’allineamento con i requisiti KYC/AML e le politiche interne, l’utente fornirà indicazioni su successione e pianificazione legacy, idoneità fiscale, pianificazione della mobilità e strutturazione della ricchezza. Il ruolo include anche la fornitura di formazione e presentazioni su strategie e opzioni di pianificazione patrimoniale conformi, aiutando i clienti a rimanere in vista di regolamenti in rapida evoluzione e sempre più complessi e proteggere la loro ricchezza, massimizzando il reddito post-tassa, e la preparazione tempestiva, accurata Wealth Planning Alerts e Memoria clienti sui temi sopra descritti. Principali responsabilità:
• Impegno attivo con i banchieri per riconoscere e anticipare le esigenze dei clienti, e per identificare e cogliere opportunità di business.
• Fornire e formare i banchieri privati con informazioni tecniche aggiornate e pertinenti per comprendere gli sviluppi fiscali e legali di impatto e agire correttamente.
• Identificare, presentare e discutere soluzioni e strategie di pianificazione patrimoniale adeguate e conformi per soddisfare le esigenze dei clienti: fornire servizi personalizzati e strategie su misura.
• Incontra clienti e prospettive (tra cui viaggi d'affari con banchieri)
• Promuovere attivamente i servizi di Wealth Planning in tutta la Banca attraverso presentazioni ad hoc e pubblicazioni su temi selezionati e ad alto impatto; sostenere attivamente gli obiettivi fiscali e legali di conservazione della ricchezza.
• Mantenere un elevato livello di competenze tecniche sui mercati dedicati e adottare un approccio efficace, basato sul rischio e focalizzato sui risultati per mitigare i rischi.
• Costruire e mantenere una rete di intermediari quali fiducia e fornitori di servizi aziendali, società fiscali e legali.
• Complessivamente ai requisiti di conformità e regolamentazione esterni e interni, comprese le politiche, le procedure operative e i controlli della Banca per soddisfare i requisiti normativi e regolamentari della Banca e proteggere il business dal rischio legale, finanziario e reputazionale.
• Integrare con il team locale di Wealth Planners con sede a Zurigo; collaborare in tutto il Gruppo UBP; rapporto al responsabile della pianificazione della ricchezza – Svizzera, con sede a Ginevra.
• Collaborare con il Dipartimento Compliance per rivedere complessi casi esistenti e strutture fiduciarie/proprietarie (trust, fondazioni, SPV) rigorosamente su base di Compliance-initiated, on-demand; verificare la proprietà benefica e strutturare i razionali di documentazione in linea con le politiche KYC/AML e le regole transfrontaliere.
• Supporto onboarding per i clienti struttura-pesante solo su richiesta di conformità: identificazione UBO, razionalità, documentazione dell'entità richiesta, grafici di proprietà e memo di giustificazione per facilitare l'approvazione della conformità.
• Eseguire revisioni periodiche ed eventi (ad esempio, aggiornamento KYC, eventi trigger) esclusivamente quando è stato avviato da Compliance. Requisiti:
• 12+ anni di esperienza rilevante nei servizi di pianificazione della ricchezza
• Competenze profonde nel Regno Unito e nella strutturazione della ricchezza anglosassone, con un comprovato record di successo in queste giurisdizioni.
• Conoscenza ampia e avanzata attraverso le principali discipline di pianificazione della ricchezza (tassa, legale, successione, governance), evidenziata da complesse esecuzioni dei casi e impatto del cliente.
• Sfondo accademico in diritto o finanza; una laurea in diritto e/o qualifica come avvocato fiscale è un vantaggio forte
• Fluency in inglese e tedesco; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio
• Confidente, persuasivo comunicatore con eccellenti capacità di presentazione
• Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta, con la capacità di semplificare argomenti complessi per il pubblico vario
• Resiliente e adattabile: in grado di eseguire sotto pressione, priorizzare efficacemente e mantenere elevati standard
• Automotivata, guidata dal servizio e instancabilmente focalizzata sui risultati del cliente
• Giocatore di squadra forte, altamente organizzato con eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli Questo è un ruolo al 100% situato a Zurigo. Inizio: asap

• Proaktives Engagement mit Bankern, um die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu erkennen und zu antizipieren sowie Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und zu nutzen.
• Bereitstellung und Schulung von Privatbankern mit aktuellen, relevanten technischen Informationen, um wirkungsvolle steuerliche und rechtliche Entwicklungen zu verstehen und angemessene Maßnahmen zu ergreifen.
• Identifizieren, präsentieren und diskutieren Sie geeignete und konforme Vermögensplanungslösungen und -strategien, um die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu erfüllen: liefern Sie maßgeschneiderte Dienstleistungen und maßgeschneiderte Strategien.
• Kunden und Interessenten treffen (einschließlich Geschäftsreisen mit Bankern)
• Aktive Förderung von Vermögensplanungsdienstleistungen in der gesamten Bank durch Ad-hoc-Präsentationen und Veröffentlichungen zu ausgewählten, einflussreichen Themen; aktive Unterstützung von steuerlichen und rechtlichen Vermögenserhaltungszielen.
• Behalten Sie ein hohes Maß an technischem Know-how in dedizierten Märkten bei und verfolgen Sie einen effektiven, risikobasierten und ergebnisorientierten Ansatz zur Risikominderung.
• Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks von Vermittlern wie Treuhand- und Unternehmensdienstleistern, Steuer- und Anwaltskanzleien. Einhaltung externer und interner Compliance- und regulatorischer Anforderungen, einschließlich der Richtlinien, Betriebsverfahren und Kontrollen der Bank, um die regulatorischen Anforderungen der Bank zu erfüllen und das Unternehmen vor rechtlichen, finanziellen und Reputationsrisiken zu schützen.
• Integration in das lokale Team von Wealth Planern mit Sitz in Zürich; Zusammenarbeit in der UBP Group; Bericht an Head of Wealth Planning – Switzerland mit Sitz in Genf.
• Partnerschaft mit der Compliance-Abteilung, um komplexe bestehende Fälle und Treuhand-/Eigentumsstrukturen (Trusts, Stiftungen, SPVs) streng auf einer Compliance-initiierten On-Demand-Basis zu überprüfen; Überprüfung des wirtschaftlichen Eigentums und der Strukturierung von Gründen im Einklang mit KYC/AML-Richtlinien und grenzüberschreitenden Regeln.
• Unterstützung des Onboardings für strukturschwere Kunden nur auf Compliance-Anfrage: UBO-Identifikation, Begründung, erforderliche Entitätsdokumentation, Eigentümerdiagramme und Begründungsmemos zur Erleichterung der Compliance-Genehmigung.
• Führen Sie periodische und ereignisbezogene Überprüfungen (z. B. KYC-Aktualisierung, Trigger-Ereignisse) ausschließlich dann durch, wenn sie von Compliance initiiert werden. Anforderungen:
• 12+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung in der Vermögensplanung
• Tiefe Expertise in der britischen und angelsächsischen Vermögensstrukturierung, mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz in diesen Ländern. Breites, fortgeschrittenes Wissen über die wichtigsten Vermögensplanungsdisziplinen (Steuern, Recht, Nachfolge, Governance), belegt durch komplexe Falldurchführung und Auswirkungen auf die Kunden.
• Akademischer Hintergrund in Recht oder Finanzen; ein Abschluss in Recht und / oder Qualifikation als Steueranwalt ist ein starkes Plus
• fließend Englisch und Deutsch; zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil
• Selbstsicherer, überzeugender Kommunikator mit hervorragenden Präsentationsfähigkeiten
• Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen für ein vielfältiges Publikum zu vereinfachen
• Belastbar und anpassungsfähig: in der Lage, unter Druck zu arbeiten, effektiv zu priorisieren und hohe Standards einzuhalten
• Selbstmotiviert, serviceorientiert und unermüdlich auf die Kundenergebnisse ausgerichtet
• Starker Teamplayer, hoch organisiert mit außergewöhnlicher Liebe zum Detail Dies ist eine 100% ige Rolle in Zürich. Start: asap
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous rejoindrez l'équipe de planification de patrimoine de l'Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) à Zurich, en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous servirez les clients et travaillerez en partenariat avec les gestionnaires des relations afin de s'assurer que les besoins en matière de planification du patrimoine sont adéquatement pris en compte. Vous fournirez des conseils sur la planification de la relève et de l'héritage, la pertinence fiscale, la planification de la mobilité et la structuration de la richesse – en fonction des circonstances particulières de chaque client – pour créer de la valeur ajoutée et atténuer les risques, en collaborant avec la conformité sur demande afin d'assurer l'alignement avec les exigences de la KYC/AML et les politiques internes. Le rôle consiste également à offrir une formation et des présentations sur les stratégies et les options de planification du patrimoine conformes, à aider les clients à demeurer en avance sur les règlements en évolution rapide et de plus en plus complexes et à protéger leur richesse tout en maximisant les revenus après impôt, et à préparer en temps opportun des alertes internes de planification du patrimoine et des notes de service sur les sujets susmentionnés. Principales responsabilités:
• Engagement proactif auprès des banquiers pour reconnaître et anticiper les besoins des clients, identifier et saisir les occasions d'affaires.
• Fournir et former des banquiers privés avec des informations techniques à jour et pertinentes pour comprendre les évolutions fiscales et juridiques pertinentes et prendre des mesures appropriées.
• Identifier, présenter et discuter des solutions et stratégies de planification de patrimoine appropriées et conformes pour répondre aux besoins des clients : offrir un service personnalisé et des stratégies sur mesure.
• Rencontrer les clients et les perspectives (y compris les voyages d'affaires avec les banquiers)
• Promouvoir activement les services de planification du patrimoine dans l'ensemble de la Banque au moyen de présentations et de publications ponctuelles sur des thèmes choisis à fort impact; soutenir activement les objectifs fiscaux et juridiques de préservation du patrimoine.
• Maintenir un niveau élevé d'expertise technique sur des marchés spécialisés et adopter une approche efficace, axée sur les risques et axée sur les résultats pour atténuer les risques.
• Créer et maintenir un réseau d'intermédiaires tels que les prestataires de services fiduciaires et de services aux entreprises, les cabinets fiscaux et les cabinets d'avocats.
• Se conformer aux exigences de conformité et de réglementation externes et internes, y compris les politiques, les procédures opérationnelles et les contrôles de la Banque pour satisfaire aux exigences de la Banque et de la réglementation et protéger l'entreprise contre les risques juridiques, financiers et de réputation.
• Intégrer avec l'équipe locale de planificateurs de patrimoine basée à Zurich; collaborer à travers le groupe UBP; faire rapport au responsable de la planification de patrimoine – Suisse, basé à Genève.
• Collaborer avec le Département de la conformité pour examiner les cas complexes existants et les structures fiduciaires/propriétés (trusts, fondations, SPV) strictement sur la base de la conformité, sur demande; vérifier la propriété effective et les justifications structurantes des documents conformément aux politiques KYC/AML et aux règles transfrontalières.
• Support à bord pour les clients lourds de structure uniquement sur demande de conformité : identification UBO, justification, documentation requise de l'entité, cartes de propriété et notes de justification pour faciliter l'approbation de conformité.
• Effectuer des examens périodiques et des examens axés sur des événements (p. ex., rafraîchissement du KYC, événements déclencheurs) exclusivement lorsqu'ils sont initiés par Conformité. Exigences:
• 12 ans et plus d'expérience dans les services de planification de patrimoine
• Une expertise approfondie au Royaume-Uni et dans la structuration de la richesse anglo-saxonne, avec un succès prouvé dans ces juridictions.
• Connaissances étendues et avancées dans les disciplines de base de la planification de la richesse (fiscalité, juridique, succession, gouvernance), mises en évidence par l'exécution de cas complexes et l'impact client.
• Études en droit ou en finances; un diplôme en droit et/ou une qualification d'avocat fiscal est un plus
• La maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand; les langues supplémentaires sont un avantage
• Communicateur fiable et persuasif avec d'excellentes compétences de présentation
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de simplifier des sujets complexes pour des publics variés
• Résilient et adaptable : capable de fonctionner sous pression, de prioriser efficacement et de maintenir des normes élevées
• Automotivé, motivé par le service et axé sans relâche sur les résultats des clients
• Fort joueur d'équipe, très organisé avec une attention exceptionnelle au détail C'est un rôle 100% situé à Zurich. Début : dès que possible

jobs.description:
• Mission
 The Intern Pricing Analyst – Securities Master File (6 months) is a critical role within the bank’s Private Banking domain, responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of security prices across all asset types.
Embedded in the Securities Master File team, this role focuses on the full pricing lifecycle: sourcing, validation, monitoring, exception handling, and controls (including delta checks, missing and stale prices), ensuring robust data quality for front office, risk, operations, performance, and client reporting.

• Duration: 6 months (interim mission)

• Team: Securities Master File (SMF)

• Scope: Pricing for all instruments within Private Banking

• Stakeholders: Front Office, Risk, Operations, Performance, Client Reporting, IT, Procurement, Data Vendors

• Key Responsibilities
• Ensure daily acquisition and validation of prices for all in-scope instruments (equities, fixed income, funds, ETFs, money market, structured products, derivatives, private placement, hedge funds).

• Execute daily pricing control framework:
• Delta price checks vs prior valid prices and tolerances.

• Missing and stale price detection and remediation.

• Ensure pricing hierarchy is well applied according to approved sourcing policies.

• Investigate discrepancies between vendors and coordinate vendor queries, challenges, and corrections.

• Resolve breaks by applying alternative sources, manual validation, or price challenges; document rationales and evidence.

• Pricing exceptions; perform root-cause analysis (stale feeds, mapping, instrument reference data gaps, pricing source provider).

• Coordinate with Corporate Actions, Fund Desk, and Operations to align price effective dates and event impacts (splits, coupons, redemptions, suspensions).

• Execute daily, weekly, and monthly pricing quality KPIs and attestations (e.g., completeness %, stale rate, exception aging, SLA adherence).

• Contribute to enhancement of pricing rules, dashboards, and controls to reduce false positives and improve STP.

• Participate in testing and validation of system changes impacting pricing

• Update and maintain operational procedures (process flows, risks, controls, KPIs) specific to pricing.

• Core Competencies
• Behave Ethically

• Communicate Effectively

• Foster Teamwork

• Creativity/Innovation

• Organize

• Solve Problems

• Specific Competencies
• Economic, mathematical, or quantitative education.

• Solid knowledge of financial instruments and pricing conventions across asset classes.

• Strong prioritization, especially under cut-off pressure and incident scenarios.

• Familiarity with pricing controls: delta checks, stale/missing detection, vendor waterfall logic

• Other Skills/Abilities

• Open mind and team orientation
• Be open to others’ ideas; balance personal and team interests.

• Express opinions and criticism constructively.

• Innovation and development
• Seek opportunities to improve existing controls and processes.

• Be a continuous learner and adopt change with a positive attitude.

• Professional business culture
• Think in Problem–Action–Results terms.

• Go beyond specific assignments and take ownership.

• Be proactive and driven with a strong client service ethic.

• Quality, internal & external regulation
• Consistently comply with internal policies, vendor contracts, and relevant regulations.

• Seek opportunities to improve quality in all aspects of the pricing process.

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione L’Analista dei prezzi interni – Securities Master File (6 mesi) è un ruolo fondamentale nel dominio Private Banking della banca, responsabile dell’accuratezza, della tempestività e dell’integrità dei prezzi di sicurezza in tutti i tipi di asset. Inserito nel team Securities Master File, questo ruolo si concentra sul ciclo di vita dei prezzi completo: sourcing, validazione, monitoraggio, gestione delle eccezioni e controlli (compresi i controlli delta, i prezzi mancanti e stanti), garantendo una robusta qualità dei dati per l'ufficio frontale, il rischio, le operazioni, le prestazioni e la segnalazione dei clienti.
• Durata: 6 mesi ( missione intermedia)
• Team: Securities Master File (SMF)
• Ambito: Prezzo per tutti gli strumenti del Private Banking
• Stakeholders: Front Office, Risk, Operazioni, Performance, Reporting client, IT, Procurement, Data Vendors
• Responsabilità chiave
• Assicurare l'acquisizione quotidiana e la validazione dei prezzi per tutti gli strumenti in-scope (equità, reddito fisso, fondi, ETF, mercato monetario, prodotti strutturati, derivati, collocamento privato, fondi di copertura).
• Eseguire il framework giornaliero di controllo dei prezzi:
• Controlli dei prezzi del Delta rispetto a prezzi e tolleranze valide precedenti.
• Rilevamento e risanamento dei prezzi mancanti e stanti.
• Assicurare la gerarchia dei prezzi è ben applicata in base alle politiche di approvvigionamento approvate.
• Indaga le discrepanze tra i fornitori e coordina le domande dei fornitori, le sfide e le correzioni.
• Risolvere le interruzioni applicando fonti alternative, la validazione manuale o le sfide dei prezzi; documentare razionali e prove.
• Eccezioni di prezzo; eseguire analisi a causa delle radici ( feed di fiabe, mappatura, gap di dati di riferimento dello strumento, fornitore di fonti di prezzi).
• Coordinare le azioni aziendali, il Fondo e le operazioni per allineare le date e gli impatti degli eventi effettivi dei prezzi (split, coupon, redenzioni, sospensioni).
• Eseguire KPI e attestazioni di qualità dei prezzi giornalieri, settimanali e mensili (ad esempio, completezza %, tasso di stallo, invecchiamento delle eccezioni, adesione SLA).
• Contribuire alla valorizzazione delle regole di prezzo, dashboard e controlli per ridurre i falsi positivi e migliorare STP.
• Partecipazione a test e validazione dei cambiamenti di sistema che influiscono sui prezzi
• Aggiornare e mantenere le procedure operative (flussi di processo, rischi, controlli, KPI) specifiche per i prezzi.

• Behave Etica
• Comunicare efficacemente
• Foster Teamwork
• Creatività/innovazione
• Organizzare
• risolvere i problemi
• Competenze specifiche
• Istruzione economica, matematica o quantitativa.
• Una solida conoscenza degli strumenti finanziari e delle convenzioni sui prezzi nelle classi di asset.
• Forte prioritizzazione, soprattutto in situazioni di pressione di taglio e incidenti.
• Familiarità con i controlli dei prezzi: controlli delta, rilevamento stallo/missivo, logica della cascata del venditore
• Altre abilità/abilità
• Aprire la mente e l'orientamento del team
• Essere aperti alle idee altrui; bilanciare gli interessi personali e di squadra.
• esprimere opinioni e critiche costruttivamente.
• Innovazione e sviluppo
• Cercate opportunità per migliorare i controlli e i processi esistenti.
• Essere un apprendimento continuo e adottare il cambiamento con un atteggiamento positivo.
• Cultura aziendale professionale
• Pensa ai termini Problem–Action–Risultati.
• Andare oltre incarichi specifici e prendere la proprietà.
• Sii proattivo e guidato con un forte servizio client etico.
• Qualità, regolazione interna ed esterna
• Coerentemente rispettare le politiche interne, i contratti dei fornitori e le normative pertinenti.
• Cercate opportunità per migliorare la qualità in tutti gli aspetti del processo di prezzi.

Eingebettet in das Securities Master File-Team konzentriert sich diese Rolle auf den gesamten Preislebenszyklus: Beschaffung, Validierung, Überwachung, Ausnahmebehandlung und Kontrollen (einschließlich Delta-Checks, fehlende und veraltete Preise), um eine robuste Datenqualität für Front Office, Risiko, Betrieb, Leistung und Kundenberichterstattung zu gewährleisten.

• Mission L'analyste des prix des stagiaires – Fichier principal des titres (6 mois) est un rôle essentiel dans le domaine de la banque Private Banking, responsable de l'exactitude, de l'actualité et de l'intégrité des prix de la sécurité pour tous les types d'actifs. Intégré à l'équipe du fichier principal des valeurs mobilières, ce rôle se concentre sur le cycle de vie complet des prix : approvisionnement, validation, surveillance, traitement des exceptions et contrôles (y compris les vérifications du delta, les prix manquants et les prix inexistants), assurant une qualité solide des données pour le front office, les risques, les opérations, les performances et les rapports clients.
• Durée: 6 mois (mission provisoire)
• Équipe : fichier principal de titres (SMF)
• Portée: Tarification pour tous les instruments de la banque privée
• Intervenants : Front Office, Risque, Opérations, Performance, Rapports clients, TI, Approvisionnement, Fournisseurs de données
• Principales responsabilités
• Assurer l'acquisition quotidienne et la validation des prix pour tous les instruments de portée (équités, revenus fixes, fonds, ETF, marché monétaire, produits structurés, dérivés, placement privé, fonds spéculatifs).
• Exécuter le cadre de contrôle quotidien des prix:
• Contrôle des prix Delta par rapport aux prix et tolérances antérieurs valables.
• Détection et remise en état des prix manquants et inexistants.
• Veiller à ce que la hiérarchie des prix soit bien appliquée conformément aux politiques d'approvisionnement approuvées.
• Étudier les divergences entre les fournisseurs et coordonner les demandes, les défis et les corrections.
• Résoudre les ruptures en appliquant des sources alternatives, une validation manuelle ou des défis de prix; documenter les justifications et les preuves.
• Exceptions en matière de tarification; analyse des causes profondes (feeds inexistants, cartographie, lacunes dans les données de référence des instruments, fournisseur de sources de tarification).
• Coordonner avec les actions de l'entreprise, le bureau des fonds et les opérations afin d'aligner les dates d'entrée en vigueur des prix et les impacts des événements (splits, coupons, rachats, suspensions).
• Exécuter quotidiennement, hebdomadairement et mensuellement des ICR et des attestations de qualité des prix (par exemple, exhaustivité %, taux d'écart, exception au vieillissement, adhésion à l'ALS).

• Mission
 The intern will support daily production controls across Investment Operations (Middle Office Wealth & Asset Management, Securities Master File team), to ensure data and process integrity for Private Banking and Asset Management.
The intern will learn core processes, tools, and controls, and contribute to continuous improvement. The role involves monitoring dashboards, investigating exceptions, documenting outcomes, and contributing to control improvements under senior guidance.

• Team: Investment Operations Quality & Business Implementation

• Stakeholders: Middle Office Asset & Wealth Management, Securities Master File team

• Main responsibilities
• Run daily 2nd level controls and sign offs across:
• Trade Processing, Reconciliations, Corporate Actions, Securities Master File & Pricing

• Perform end-of-day sign-offs and maintain audit trails for manual fixes/overrides.

• Update procedures and checklists; contribute to small control/process improvements.

• Collaborate with Middle Office, SMF, Corporate Actions, Performance, and IT for issue resolution.

• Investigate exceptions, document evidence and resolutions; maintain robust audit trails.

• Core Competencies
• Behave Ethically

• Communicate Effectively

• Foster Teamwork

• Creativity/Innovation

• Organize

• Solve Problems

• Specific Competencies
• Economic, mathematical, or quantitative education.

• Solid knowledge of financial instruments.

• Strong prioritization, especially under cut-off pressure and incident scenarios.

• Other Skills/Abilities

• Open mind and team orientation
• Be open to others’ ideas; balance personal and team interests.

• Express opinions and criticism constructively.

• Innovation and development
• Seek opportunities to improve existing controls and processes.

• Be a continuous learner and adopt change with a positive attitude.

• Professional business culture
• Think in Problem–Action–Results terms.

• Go beyond specific assignments and take ownership.

• Be proactive and driven with a strong client service ethic.

• Quality, internal & external regulation
• Consistently comply with internal policies, vendor contracts, and relevant regulations.

• Seek opportunities to improve quality in all aspects of the pricing process.

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
